# Load raw data

## Annotation database

```{r Download annotation database, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 1m 20s
  # Downloaded on 2023-07-28
  mart=
    useMart('ensembl')
  
  mart %>%
    saveRDS(file='raw_data/mart.rds')
  
  # Downloaded on 2023-07-28
  ensembl=
    useDataset('hsapiens_gene_ensembl',mart)
  
  ensembl %>%
    saveRDS(file='raw_data/ensembl.rds')
}else{
  mart=
    readRDS(file='raw_data/mart.rds')
  
  ensembl=
    readRDS(file='raw_data/ensembl.rds')
}
```

```{r Identify a platform annotation, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
listAttributes(ensembl)
```

## GSE75010

```{r GSE75010 - Visit experiment page and create list-folder, include=FALSE}
# Visit https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE75010

GSE75010=list()

GSE75010$folder='raw_data/GSE75010/'

if(!dir.exists(GSE75010$folder)){
  GSE75010$folder %>%
    dir.create(recursive=T)
}
```

```{r GSE75010 - Expression set, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 01m 04s
  # Downloaded on 2023-07-28
  curl::curl_download(
    paste0(
      'https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/'
      ,'GSE75nnn/GSE75010/matrix/GSE75010_series_matrix.txt.gz'
    )
    ,paste0(
      GSE75010$folder
      ,'GSE75010_series_matrix.txt.gz'
    )
  )
}

GSE75010$eset=
  GEOquery::getGEO(
    filename='raw_data/GSE75010/GSE75010_series_matrix.txt.gz'
    ,destdir='raw_data/GSE75010/'
    ,GSEMatrix=T
    ,getGPL=F
    ,AnnotGPL=F
    ,parseCharacteristics=F
  )
```

```{r GSE75010 - Phenotype data, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 32m 45s
  # Downloaded on 2023-07-28
  curl::curl_download(
    paste0(
      'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/download/'
      ,'?acc=GSE75010&format=file'
    )
    ,paste0(
      GSE75010$folder
      ,'GSE75010_RAW.tar'
    )
  )
  
  paste0(
      GSE75010$folder
      ,'GSE75010_RAW.tar'
    ) %>%
    untar(
      exdir=
        paste0(
          GSE75010$folder
          ,'raw'
        )
    )
  
  paste0(
      GSE75010$folder
      ,'GSE75010_RAW.tar'
    ) %>%
    file.remove()
}

GSE75010$pData=
  list.files('raw_data/GSE75010/raw') %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  setNames('path') %>%
  mutate(
    id=
      path %>%
      str_extract_all('GSM[:digit:]+') %>%
      sapply(\(x)x[[1]])
  ) %>%
  right_join(
    pData(GSE75010$eset) %>%
      rownames_to_column(var='id')
    ,by='id'
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var='id') %>%
  .[colnames(GSE75010$eset),]
```

```{r GSE75010 - Assay data, include=FALSE}
GSE75010$raw=
  read.celfiles(
    paste0('raw_data/GSE75010/raw/',GSE75010$pData$path)
    ,sampleNames=colnames(GSE75010$eset)
  )

if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 06m 10s
  GSE75010$unnorm=
    GSE75010$raw %>%
    rma(background=T,normalize=F)
  
  GSE75010$unnorm %>%
    saveRDS('raw_data/GSE75010/GSE75010_unnorm.rds')
  
  GSE75010$norm=
    GSE75010$raw %>%
    rma(background=T,normalize=T)
  
  GSE75010$norm %>%
    saveRDS('raw_data/GSE75010/GSE75010_norm.rds')
}else{
  GSE75010$unnorm=
    readRDS('raw_data/GSE75010/GSE75010_unnorm.rds')
  
  GSE75010$norm=
    readRDS('raw_data/GSE75010/GSE75010_norm.rds')
}
```

```{r GSE75010 - Feature data, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 02m 14s
  # Downloaded on 2023-07-28
  GSE75010$fData=
    download_annotation(
      platform='affy_hugene_1_0_st_v1'
      ,mart=ensembl
    ) %>%
    .[intersect(rownames(GSE75010$norm),rownames(.)),]
  
  GSE75010$fData %>%
    saveRDS('raw_data/GSE75010/GSE75010_fData.rds')
}else{
  GSE75010$fData=
    readRDS('raw_data/GSE75010/GSE75010_fData.rds')
}
```

```{r GSE75010 - Sample outliers by RLE (SOR), include=FALSE}
GSE75010$RLE_data=
  suspected_outliers(GSE75010$unnorm)
```

```{r GSE75010 - Plot SOR, eval=FALSE, fig.height=9, fig.width=9, include=FALSE}
GSE75010$RLE_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=sample_id,y=RLE,fill=suspect_outlier)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank())
```

```{r GSE75010 - Sample outliers by HClust (SOH), include=FALSE}
GSE75010$sample_hclust=
  parallelDist(
    t(exprs(GSE75010$unnorm))
    ,method='manhattan'
  ) %>%
  hclust(method='complete')
```

```{r GSE75010 - Sample outliers (SO), include=FALSE}
GSE75010$outliers=
  cutree(GSE75010$sample_hclust,k=3) %>%
  .[. %in% 2:3] %>%
  names() %>%
  intersect(
    GSE75010$RLE_data %>%
      filter(suspect_outlier=='yes') %>%
      .$sample_id %>%
      .[!duplicated(.)]
  )

GSE75010$sample_hclust$labels=
  ifelse(
    GSE75010$sample_hclust$labels %in% GSE75010$outliers
    ,GSE75010$sample_hclust$labels
    ,''
  )
```

```{r GSE75010 - Plot SO, eval=FALSE, fig.height=9, fig.width=9, include=FALSE}
plot(GSE75010$sample_hclust,cex=0.6)
rect.hclust(GSE75010$sample_hclust,k=3,border=2:4)
```

```{r GSE75010 - Low-expressed probes (LEP), include=FALSE}
GSE75010$low_exp_probes=
  rownames(GSE75010$norm) %>%
  .[rowMedians(exprs(GSE75010$norm))
    <=quantile(
      rowMedians(exprs(GSE75010$norm))
      ,GSE75010$norm %>%
        exprs() %>%
        rowMedians() %>%
        cut(breaks=100) %>%
        table() %>%
        which.max() %>%
        sapply(\(x)round(x*0.75)/100)
    )
  ]
```

```{r GSE75010 - LEP, eval=FALSE, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=3.5, include=FALSE}
GSE75010$norm %>%
  exprs() %>%
  rowMedians() %>%
  hist(100)

abline(
  v=quantile(
      rowMedians(exprs(GSE75010$norm))
      ,GSE75010$norm %>%
        exprs() %>%
        rowMedians() %>%
        cut(breaks=100) %>%
        table() %>%
        which.max() %>%
        sapply(\(x)round(x*0.75)/100)
    )
  ,col=2
  ,lwd=3
)
```

```{r GSE75010 - New expression set without LEP and SO, include=FALSE}
GSE75010$filt_eset=
  ExpressionSet(
    assayData=
      GSE75010$unnorm[rownames(GSE75010$fData),rownames(GSE75010$pData)] %>%
      exprs()
    ,phenoData=
      AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE75010$pData)
    ,featureData=
      AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE75010$fData)
    ,protocolData=
      protocolData(GSE75010$eset)
    ,experimentData=
      experimentData(GSE75010$eset)
    ,annotation=
      annotation(GSE75010$eset)
  ) %>%
  .[!(rownames(.) %in% GSE75010$low_exp_probes)
    ,!(colnames(.) %in% GSE75010$outliers)
  ]
```

```{r GSE75010 - Summarize to HGNC symbol, include=FALSE}
GSE75010$sum_to_hgnc=
  collapseRows(
    datET=
      exprs(GSE75010$filt_eset)
    ,rowID=
      rownames(GSE75010$filt_eset)
    ,rowGroup=
      fData(GSE75010$filt_eset)['hgnc_symbol'] %>%
      as.list() %>%
      unlist()
  )
```

```{r GSE75010 - HGNC expression set, include=FALSE}
GSE75010$hgnc_eset=
  ExpressionSet(
    assayData=
      GSE75010$sum_to_hgnc$datETcollapsed
    ,phenoData=
      AnnotatedDataFrame(pData(GSE75010$filt_eset))
    ,featureData=
      GSE75010$sum_to_hgnc$group2row %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      setNames(c('hgnc_symbol','probe_id')) %>%
      left_join(
        GSE75010$fData %>%
          rownames_to_column(var='probe_id')
        ,by=c('hgnc_symbol','probe_id')
      ) %>%
      column_to_rownames(var='hgnc_symbol') %>% 
      AnnotatedDataFrame()
    ,protocolData=
      protocolData(GSE75010$filt_eset)
    ,experimentData=
      experimentData(GSE75010$filt_eset)
    ,annotation=
      annotation(GSE75010$filt_eset)
  )
```


```{r EMTAB680 - Plot SOR, eval=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5, include=FALSE}
EMTAB680$RLE_data %>%

```

```{r EMTAB680 - Sample outliers by HClust (SOH), include=FALSE}
EMTAB680$sample_hclust=
  parallelDist(
    t(exprs(EMTAB680$unnorm))
    ,method='manhattan'
  ) %>%
  hclust(method='complete')
```

```{r EMTAB680 - Sample outliers (SO), include=FALSE}
EMTAB680$outliers=
  cutree(EMTAB680$sample_hclust,k=2) %>%
  .[. %in% 1] %>%
  names() %>%
  intersect(
    EMTAB680$RLE_data %>%
      filter(suspect_outlier=='yes') %>%
      .$sample_id %>%
      .[!duplicated(.)]
  )

EMTAB680$sample_hclust$labels=
  ifelse(
    EMTAB680$sample_hclust$labels %in% EMTAB680$outliers
    ,EMTAB680$sample_hclust$labels
    ,''
  )
```

```{r GSE9984 - Sample outliers (SO), include=FALSE}
  .[. %in% c(3,4)] %>%
  names() %>%
  intersect(
    GSE9984$RLE_data %>%
      filter(suspect_outlier=='yes') %>%
      .$sample_id %>%
      .[!duplicated(.)]
  )

GSE9984$sample_hclust$labels=
  ifelse(
    GSE9984$sample_hclust$labels %in% GSE9984$outliers
    ,GSE9984$sample_hclust$labels
    ,''
  )
```

```{r GSE30186 - Visit experiment page and create list-folder, include=FALSE}
}
```

```{r GSE30186 - Expression set, include=FALSE}

    paste0(
      'https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/'
      ,'GSE30nnn/GSE30186/matrix/GSE30186_series_matrix.txt.gz'
    )
    ,paste0(
      GSE30186$folder
      ,'GSE30186_series_matrix.txt.gz'
    )
  )
}

GSE30186$eset=
  GEOquery::getGEO(
    filename='raw_data/GSE30186/GSE30186_series_matrix.txt.gz'
    ,destdir='raw_data/GSE30186/'
    ,GSEMatrix=T
    ,getGPL=F
    ,AnnotGPL=F
```

```{r GSE30186 - Phenotype data, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 12m 15s
  # Downloaded on 2023-07-30
  curl::curl_download(
    paste0(
      'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/download/'
      ,'?acc=GSE30186&format=file'
    )
    ,paste0(
      GSE30186$folder
      ,'GSE30186_RAW.tar'
    )
  )
  
  paste0(
      GSE30186$folder
      ,'GSE30186_RAW.tar'
    ) %>%
    untar(
      exdir=
        paste0(
          GSE30186$folder
          ,'raw'
        )
    )
  
  paste0(
      GSE30186$folder
      ,'GSE30186_RAW.tar'
    ) %>%
    file.remove()
  
  paste0(
      GSE30186$folder
      ,'raw'
    ) %>%
    list.files(full.names=T) %>%
    lapply(R.utils::gunzip)
}

GSE30186$pData=
  GSE30186$eset %>%
  pData() %>%
  mutate(path=NA) %>%
  select(path,everything())
```

```{r GSE30186 - Assay data, include=FALSE}
GSE30186$raw=
  GSE30186$eset

if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 02m 07s
  GSE30186$unnorm=
    GSE30186$eset %>%
    backgroundCorrect.matrix() %>%
    oligo::summarize(probes=rownames(.)) %>%
    .[rownames(fData(GSE30186$eset)),] %>%
    ExpressionSet(
      assayData=.
      ,phenoData=AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE30186$pData)
      ,featureData=AnnotatedDataFrame(fData(GSE30186$eset))
      ,protocolData=protocolData(GSE30186$eset)
      ,experimentData=experimentData(GSE30186$eset)
      ,annotation=annotation(GSE30186$eset)
    )
  
  saveRDS(GSE30186$unnorm,'raw_data/GSE30186/GSE30186_unnorm.rds')
  
  GSE30186$norm=
    GSE30186$eset %>%
    backgroundCorrect.matrix() %>%
    oligo::normalize() %>%
    `dimnames<-`(dimnames(GSE30186$eset)) %>%
    oligo::summarize(probes=rownames(.)) %>%
    .[rownames(fData(GSE30186$eset)),] %>%
    ExpressionSet(
      assayData=.
      ,phenoData=AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE30186$pData)
      ,featureData=AnnotatedDataFrame(fData(GSE30186$eset))
      ,protocolData=protocolData(GSE30186$eset)
      ,experimentData=experimentData(GSE30186$eset)
      ,annotation=annotation(GSE30186$eset)
    )
  
  saveRDS(GSE30186$norm,'raw_data/GSE30186/GSE30186_norm.rds')
}else{
  GSE30186$unnorm=
    readRDS('raw_data/GSE30186/GSE30186_unnorm.rds')
  
  GSE30186$norm=
    readRDS('raw_data/GSE30186/GSE30186_norm.rds')
}
```

```{r GSE24129 - Visit experiment page and create list-folder, include=FALSE}
# Visit https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE24129

GSE24129=list()

GSE24129$folder='raw_data/GSE24129/'

if(!dir.exists(GSE24129$folder)){
  GSE24129$folder %>%
    dir.create(recursive=T)
}
```

```{r GSE24129 - Expression set, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 01m 03s
  # Downloaded on 2023-07-30
  curl::curl_download(
    paste0(
      'https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/'
      ,'GSE24nnn/GSE24129/matrix/GSE24129_series_matrix.txt.gz'
    )
    ,paste0(
      GSE24129$folder
      ,'GSE24129_series_matrix.txt.gz'
    )
  )
}

GSE24129$eset=
  GEOquery::getGEO(
    filename='raw_data/GSE24129/GSE24129_series_matrix.txt.gz'
    ,destdir='raw_data/GSE24129/'
    ,GSEMatrix=T
    ,getGPL=F
    ,AnnotGPL=F
    ,parseCharacteristics=F
  )
```

```{r GSE24129 - Phenotype data, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 02m 10s
  # Downloaded on 2023-07-30
  curl::curl_download(
    paste0(
      'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/download/'
      ,'?acc=GSE24129&format=file'
    )
    ,paste0(
      GSE24129$folder
      ,'GSE24129_RAW.tar'
    )
  )
  
  paste0(
      GSE24129$folder
      ,'GSE24129_RAW.tar'
    ) %>%
    untar(
      exdir=
        paste0(
          GSE24129$folder
          ,'raw'
        )
    )
  
  paste0(
      GSE24129$folder
      ,'GSE24129_RAW.tar'
    ) %>%
    file.remove()
}

GSE24129$pData=
  list.files('raw_data/GSE24129/raw') %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  setNames('path') %>%
  mutate(
    id=
      path %>%
      str_extract_all('GSM[:digit:]+') %>%
      sapply(\(x)x[[1]])
  ) %>%
  right_join(
    pData(GSE24129$eset) %>%
      rownames_to_column(var='id')
    ,by='id'
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var='id') %>%
  .[colnames(GSE24129$eset),]
```

```{r GSE24129 - Assay data, include=FALSE}
GSE24129$raw=
  read.celfiles(
    paste0('raw_data/GSE24129/raw/',GSE24129$pData$path)
    ,sampleNames=colnames(GSE24129$eset)
  )

if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 02m 45s
  GSE24129$unnorm=
    GSE24129$raw %>%
    rma(background=T,normalize=F)
  
  GSE24129$unnorm %>%
    saveRDS('raw_data/GSE24129/GSE24129_unnorm.rds')
  
  GSE24129$norm=
    GSE24129$raw %>%
    rma(background=T,normalize=T)
  
  GSE24129$norm %>%
    saveRDS('raw_data/GSE24129/GSE24129_norm.rds')
}else{
  GSE24129$unnorm=
    readRDS('raw_data/GSE24129/GSE24129_unnorm.rds')
  
  GSE24129$norm=
    readRDS('raw_data/GSE24129/GSE24129_norm.rds')
}
```

```{r GSE24129 - Feature data, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 01m 01s
  # Downloaded on 2023-07-30
  GSE24129$fData=
    download_annotation(
      platform='affy_hugene_1_0_st_v1'
      ,mart=ensembl
    ) %>%
    .[intersect(rownames(GSE24129$norm),rownames(.)),]
  
  GSE24129$fData %>%
    saveRDS('raw_data/GSE24129/GSE24129_fData.rds')
}else{
  GSE24129$fData=
    readRDS('raw_data/GSE24129/GSE24129_fData.rds')
}
```

```{r GSE24129 - Sample outliers by RLE (SOR), include=FALSE}
GSE24129$RLE_data=
  suspected_outliers(GSE24129$unnorm)
```

```{r GSE24129 - Plot SOR, eval=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5, include=FALSE}
GSE24129$RLE_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=sample_id,y=RLE,fill=suspect_outlier)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank())
```

```{r GSE24129 - Sample outliers by HClust (SOH), include=FALSE}
GSE24129$sample_hclust=
  parallelDist(
    t(exprs(GSE24129$unnorm))
    ,method='manhattan'
  ) %>%
  hclust(method='complete')
```

```{r GSE24129 - Sample outliers (SO), include=FALSE}
GSE24129$outliers=
  cutree(GSE24129$sample_hclust,k=3) %>%
  .[. %in% 3] %>%
  names() %>%
  intersect(
    GSE24129$RLE_data %>%
      filter(suspect_outlier=='yes') %>%
      .$sample_id %>%
      .[!duplicated(.)]
  )

GSE24129$sample_hclust$labels=
  ifelse(
    GSE24129$sample_hclust$labels %in% GSE24129$outliers
    ,GSE24129$sample_hclust$labels
    ,''
  )
```

```{r GSE24129 - Plot SO, eval=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5, include=FALSE}
plot(GSE24129$sample_hclust,cex=0.6)
rect.hclust(GSE24129$sample_hclust,k=3,border=2:4)
```

```{r GSE24129 - Low-expressed probes (LEP), include=FALSE}
GSE24129$low_exp_probes=
  rownames(GSE24129$norm) %>%
  .[rowMedians(exprs(GSE24129$norm))
    <=quantile(
      rowMedians(exprs(GSE24129$norm))
      ,GSE24129$norm %>%
        exprs() %>%
        rowMedians() %>%
        cut(breaks=100) %>%
        table() %>%
        which.max() %>%
        sapply(\(x)round(x*0.75)/100)
    )
  ]
```

```{r GSE24129 - LEP, eval=FALSE, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=3.5, include=FALSE}
GSE24129$norm %>%
  exprs() %>%
  rowMedians() %>%
  hist(100)

abline(
  v=quantile(
      rowMedians(exprs(GSE24129$norm))
      ,GSE24129$norm %>%
        exprs() %>%
        rowMedians() %>%
        cut(breaks=100) %>%
        table() %>%
        which.max() %>%
        sapply(\(x)round(x*0.75)/100)
    )
  ,col=2
  ,lwd=3
)
```

```{r GSE24129 - New expression set without LEP and SO, include=FALSE}
GSE24129$filt_eset=
  ExpressionSet(
    assayData=
      GSE24129$unnorm[rownames(GSE24129$fData),rownames(GSE24129$pData)] %>%
      exprs()
    ,phenoData=
      AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE24129$pData)
    ,featureData=
      AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE24129$fData)
    ,protocolData=
      protocolData(GSE24129$eset)
    ,experimentData=
      experimentData(GSE24129$eset)
    ,annotation=
      annotation(GSE24129$eset)
  ) %>%
  .[!(rownames(.) %in% GSE24129$low_exp_probes)
    ,!(colnames(.) %in% GSE24129$outliers)
  ]
```

```{r GSE24129 - Summarize to HGNC symbol, include=FALSE}
GSE24129$sum_to_hgnc=
  collapseRows(
    datET=
      exprs(GSE24129$filt_eset)
    ,rowID=
      rownames(GSE24129$filt_eset)
    ,rowGroup=
      fData(GSE24129$filt_eset)['hgnc_symbol'] %>%
      as.list() %>%
      unlist()
  )
```

```{r GSE24129 - HGNC expression set, include=FALSE}
GSE24129$hgnc_eset=
  ExpressionSet(
    assayData=
      GSE24129$sum_to_hgnc$datETcollapsed
    ,phenoData=
      AnnotatedDataFrame(pData(GSE24129$filt_eset))
    ,featureData=
      GSE24129$sum_to_hgnc$group2row %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      setNames(c('hgnc_symbol','probe_id')) %>%
      left_join(
        GSE24129$fData %>%
          rownames_to_column(var='probe_id')
        ,by=c('hgnc_symbol','probe_id')
      ) %>%
      column_to_rownames(var='hgnc_symbol') %>% 
      AnnotatedDataFrame()
    ,protocolData=
      protocolData(GSE24129$filt_eset)
    ,experimentData=
      experimentData(GSE24129$filt_eset)
    ,annotation=
      annotation(GSE24129$filt_eset)
  )
```

```{r GSE44711 - Phenotype data, include=FALSE}
    GSE44711$eset %>%
```

```{r GSE44711 - Assay data, include=FALSE}
    oligo::normalize() %>%
    `dimnames<-`(dimnames(GSE44711$eset)) %>%
    oligo::summarize(probes=rownames(.)) %>%
    .[rownames(fData(GSE44711$eset)),] %>%
    ExpressionSet(
      assayData=.
      ,phenoData=AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE44711$pData)
      ,featureData=AnnotatedDataFrame(fData(GSE44711$eset))
      ,protocolData=protocolData(GSE44711$eset)

  )
```

```{r Check_duplicates, include=FALSE}
poi=
  rbind(
    poi0 %>%
      filter(!(gsm %in% poi0$gsm[duplicated(poi0$gsm)]))
    ,poi0 %>%
      filter(
        gsm %in% poi0$gsm[duplicated(poi0$gsm)]
        & gse=='GSE98224'
      )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(
      gse
      ,c('GSE4888','GSE6364','EMTAB680','GSE12767','GSE9984'
         ,'GSE75010','GSE98224','GSE100415'
         ,'GSE30186','GSE10588','GSE24129','GSE25906','GSE4707','GSE44711'
         ,'GSE128381'
       )
    )
    ,gsm
  )
```

## Discovery set, associated factor

```{r Endometrium, include=FALSE}
grouping0$E_PRE=
  poi %>%
  filter(set=='Discovery set, Associated factor, Endometrium') %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(str_to_lower(end_phase),'proliferative')
    & !str_detect(str_to_lower(others),'endometriosis')
    & !str_detect(str_to_lower(others),'adenomyosis')
  )
  
grouping0$E_ESE=
  poi %>%
  filter(set=='Discovery set, Associated factor, Endometrium') %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(str_to_lower(end_phase),'early')
    & str_detect(str_to_lower(end_phase),'secretory')
    & !str_detect(str_to_lower(others),'endometriosis')
    & !str_detect(str_to_lower(others),'adenomyosis')
  )
  
grouping0$E_MSE=
  poi %>%
  filter(set=='Discovery set, Associated factor, Endometrium') %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(str_to_lower(end_phase),'mid')
    & str_detect(str_to_lower(end_phase),'secretory')
    & !str_detect(str_to_lower(others),'endometriosis')
    & !str_detect(str_to_lower(others),'adenomyosis')
  )
  
grouping0$E_LSE=
  poi %>%
  filter(set=='Discovery set, Associated factor, Endometrium') %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(str_to_lower(end_phase),'late')
    & str_detect(str_to_lower(end_phase),'secretory')
    & !str_detect(str_to_lower(others),'endometriosis')
    & !str_detect(str_to_lower(others),'adenomyosis')
  )
```

```{r Chorioamnionitis, include=FALSE}
  filter(set=='Discovery set, Outcome, Placenta') %>%
  filter((as.numeric(ga)+as.numeric(ga2)/7)>=27) %>%

  filter((as.numeric(ga)+as.numeric(ga2)/7)>=27) %>%
```
```{r Control, include=FALSE}
  filter(
```
```{r Preeclampsia, include=FALSE}
    str_detect(title,'PE')
```
```{r Preeclampsia with FGR, include=FALSE}
    & (str_detect(title,'SGA') | str_detect(title,'FGR') | iugr=='Yes')
```
```{r Superimposed preeclampsia, include=FALSE}
    & !((prev_ht=='No' | is.na(prev_ht) | prev_ht=='NA')
        & !str_detect(title,'CH')
    )
    & (as.numeric(max_dbp)>=110
       | as.numeric(max_sbp)>=160
       | !(hellp=='No' | is.na(hellp) | hellp=='NA')
    )
    & (as.numeric(ga)+as.numeric(ga2)/7)>=34
```
```{r Remove validation groups not overlapped on discovery ones, include=FALSE}
  )

grouping=grouping0
```

```{r}
        ,str_detect(set_code,'[DV]_EOMPE_FGR')

        ,str_detect(set_code,'[DV]_LOMPE_FGR')

        ,str_detect(set_code,'SIM_EOMPE$')
         ~'Superimposed preeclampsia, early-onset, mild-to-moderate (EOMPE)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'SIM_LOMPE$')
         ~'Superimposed preeclampsia, late-onset, mild-to-moderate (LOMPE)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'SIM_EOSPE$')
         ~'Superimposed preeclampsia, early-onset, severe (EOSPE)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'SIM_LOSPE$')
         ~'Superimposed preeclampsia, late-onset, severe (LOSPE)'
        
        ,str_detect(set_code,'SIM_EOMPE_FGR')
         ~'Superimposed preeclampsia with fetal growth restriction, early-onset, mild-to-moderate (EOMPE-FGR)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'SIM_LOMPE_FGR')
         ~'Superimposed preeclampsia with fetal growth restriction, late-onset, mild-to-moderate (LOMPE-FGR)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'SIM_EOSPE_FGR')
         ~'Superimposed preeclampsia with fetal growth restriction, early-onset, severe (EOSPE-FGR)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'SIM_LOSPE_FGR')
         ~'Superimposed preeclampsia with fetal growth restriction, late-onset, severe (LOSPE-FGR)'
        
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_EGH$')
         ~'Gestational hypertension, early-onset (EGH)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_LGH$')
         ~'Gestational hypertension, late-onset (LGH)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_ECH$')
         ~'Chronic hypertension, early-onset (ECH)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_LCH$')
         ~'Chronic hypertension, late-onset (LCH)'
        
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_EGH_FGR')
         ~'Gestational hypertension with fetal growth restriction, early-onset (EGH-FGR)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_LGH_FGR')
         ~'Gestational hypertension with fetal growth restriction, late-onset (LGH-FGR)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_ECH_FGR')
         ~'Chronic hypertension with fetal growth restriction, early-onset (ECH-FGR)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_LCH_FGR')
         ~'Chronic hypertension with fetal growth restriction, late-onset (LCH-FGR)'
        
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_EFGR')
         ~'Isolated fetal growth restriction, early-onset (EFGR)'
        ,str_detect(set_code,'_LFGR')
         ~'Isolated fetal growth restriction, late-onset (LFGR)'
      )
    ,variable=
      case_when(
        variable=='Associated factor'~'Associated factor'
        ,variable=='Outcome' & str_detect(set_code,'NC|CHOR|NH|HELLP')
         ~'Associated factor'
        ,variable=='Outcome'~'Subtype'
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    set_code=factor(set_code,unique(set_code))
    ,set=factor(set,unique(set))
    ,tissue=factor(tissue,unique(tissue))
    ,gse=factor(gse,unique(gse))
  ) %>%
  rename(description=set_code) %>%
  group_by(variable,set,tissue,description,gse) %>%
  summarise(gsm=paste0(gsm,collapse=', ')) %>%
  knitr::kable() %>%
  kableExtra::kable_classic()
```

```{r}
grouping %>%
  .[!str_detect(names(.),'OV|count_nrow')] %>%
  lapply(X=names(.),Y=.,function(X,Y){
    Y[[X]] %>%
      mutate(set_code=X) %>%
      select(set_code,everything())
  }) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.) %>%
  select(-gse,-gsm,-title) %>%
  separate(set,c('set','variable','tissue'),', ') %>%
  mutate(
    variable=
      case_when(
        variable=='Associated factor'~'Associated factor'
        ,variable=='Outcome' & str_detect(set_code,'NC|CHOR|NH|HELLP')
         ~'Associated factor'
        ,variable=='Outcome'~'Subtype'
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ga=as.numeric(ga)+as.numeric(ga2)/7
  ) %>%
  select(-ga2) %>%
  mutate(
    set_code=factor(set_code,unique(set_code))
    ,set=factor(set,unique(set))
    ,variable=factor(variable,unique(variable))
    ,tissue=factor(tissue,unique(tissue))
  ) %>%
  group_by(set_code,set,variable,tissue) %>%
  mutate(n=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  gather(variable,value,-set_code,-set,-variable,-tissue,-n) %>%
  rbind(
    grouping %>%
      .[str_detect(names(.),'OV')] %>%
      lapply(X=names(.),Y=.,function(X,Y){
        Y[[X]] %>%
          lapply(X=names(.),Y=.,Z=X,function(X,Y,Z){
            if('ref10th'%in%names(Y[[X]])){
              Y[[X]] %>%
                mutate(set_code=Z) %>%
                select(set_code,everything())
            }else{
              Y[[X]] %>%
                mutate(set_code=Z,ref10th=NA) %>%
                select(set_code,everything())
            }
          }) %>%
          do.call(rbind,.)
      }) %>%
      do.call(rbind,.) %>%
      select(-gse,-gsm,-title) %>%
      separate(set,c('set','variable','tissue'),', ') %>%
      mutate(
        variable=
          case_when(
            variable=='Associated factor'~'Associated factor'
            ,variable=='Outcome' & str_detect(set_code,'NC|CHOR|NH|HELLP')
             ~'Associated factor'
            ,variable=='Outcome'~'Subtype'
          )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        ga=case_when(
          ga%in%c('Placental tissue from normal pregnancy','Control')~'37'
          ,ga%in%c('EOPET')~'34'
          ,TRUE~ga
        )
        ,ga2=ifelse(is.na(ga2),0,ga2)
        ,ga=as.numeric(ga)+as.numeric(ga2)/7
      ) %>%
      select(-ga2) %>%
      mutate(
        set_code=factor(set_code,unique(set_code))
        ,set=factor(set,unique(set))
        ,variable=factor(variable,unique(variable))
        ,tissue=factor(tissue,unique(tissue))
      ) %>%
      group_by(set_code,set,variable,tissue) %>%
      mutate(n=n()) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      gather(variable,value,-set_code,-set,-variable,-tissue,-n)
  ) %>%
  group_by(set_code,set,tissue,variable,n) %>%
  filter(mean(is.na(value))<1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  lapply(X=1:2,Y=.,function(X,Y){
    if(X==1){
      Y %>%
        filter(!str_detect(value,'[:digit:]')) %>%
        group_by(set_code,set,tissue,variable,value,n) %>%
        summarise(non_missing=n()) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(p=non_missing/n) %>%
        mutate(
          stat=
            paste0(
              non_missing,'/',n
              ,' ('
              ,ifelse(
                n<=10
                ,round(p*100)
                ,ifelse(
                  n<=100
                  ,round(p*100,1)
                  ,round(p*100,2)
                )
              )
              ,'%)'
            )
        ) %>%
        select(-non_missing,-n,-p)
    }else{
      Y %>%
        filter(
          str_detect(value,'[:digit:]') & !str_detect(value,'[:alpha:]')
        ) %>%
        mutate(value=as.numeric(value)) %>%
        group_by(set_code,set,tissue,variable,n) %>%
        mutate(
          non_missing=n()
          ,q1=quantile(value,0.25)
          ,q3=quantile(value,0.75)
          ,iqr=q3-q1
          ,out_lb=q1-1.5*iqr
          ,out_ub=q3+1.5*iqr
          ,outlier=value<out_lb & value>out_ub
        ) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        group_by(set_code,set,tissue,variable,n,non_missing) %>%
        summarise(
          avg=mean(ifelse(outlier,NA,value),na.rm=T)
          ,sd=sd(ifelse(outlier,NA,value),na.rm=T)
          ,outlier_n=sum(outlier)
        ) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(missing_n=n-non_missing) %>%
        select(-non_missing) %>%
        mutate(
          value=NA
         ,stat=
            paste0(
              round(avg,2)
              ,' ± '
              ,ifelse(
                is.na(sd)
                ,''
                ,round(sd,2)
              )
              ,' ('
              ,'n='
              ,n,'; '
              ,'outlier='
              ,outlier_n,'; '
              ,'missing='
              ,missing_n
              ,')'
            )
        ) %>%
        select(-n,-avg,-sd,-outlier_n,-missing_n)
    }
  })%>%
  do.call(rbind,.) %>%
  lapply(X=grouping %>%
           .[str_detect(names(.),'count_nrow')] %>%
           .[[1]] %>%
           unite(event,group,event,sep='_',remove=F) %>%
           unite(nonevent,group,non_event,sep='_') %>%
           select(event,nonevent) %>%
           lapply(X=seq(nrow(.)),Y=.,function(X,Y)c(Y$event[X],Y$nonevent[X]))
         ,Y=.
         ,function(X,Y){
    Y %>%
      filter(set_code%in%X) %>%
      mutate(
        set_code=factor(set_code,X)
        ,set_code=
          ifelse(
            set_code==levels(set_code)[1]
            ,'event'
            ,'nonevent'
          )
        ,comparison=paste0(X,collapse=' vs. ')
      ) %>%
      spread(set_code,stat)
  }) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.) %>%
  knitr::kable() %>%
  kableExtra::kable_classic()
```

```{r Combine esets and the comparisons with common genes, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 01m 03s

      GSE4888=GSE4888

      ,GSE9984=GSE9984

      ,GSE4707=GSE4707
      ,GSE44711=GSE44711
      ,GSE128381=GSE128381
    ) %>%
    
    # Combine the pairs of comparisons
```

```{r Show PCA of data integration, eval=FALSE, fig.height=11, fig.width=5.87, include=FALSE}
      strip.text.x=element_blank()
      ,strip.background.x=element_blank()
      ,legend.position='bottom'
    )
  ,nrow=6
  ,ncol=1
  ,widths=c(5.87)
  ,heights=c(1.8,1.6,1.6,1.6,1.6,2.8)
)
```

```{r Normalize comparison and conduct sample size estimation, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 09m 47s
  clist=

    clist %>%

    # Compute and integrate minimum sample size for FDR for each expression set
    FDR_min_size()

}else{

}
```

# Differential Expression Analysis (DEA)

```{r DEA and surrogate variable analysis (SVA) and volcano plot, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 01m 07s
  dea_results=
    clist[!(names(clist) %>% str_detect('OV_'))] %>%
    lapply(conduct_dea) %>%
    setNames(names(clist) %>% .[!str_detect(.,'OV_')])
  
  saveRDS(dea_results,'data_pec/dea_results.rds')
}else{
  dea_results=readRDS('data_pec/dea_results.rds')
}
```

```{r Identify validation sets, include=FALSE}
disc_val_sets=
  paste0(
    'OV_',
    intersect(
      names(clist) %>%
        .[str_detect(.,'OD_')] %>%
        str_split_fixed('_',2) %>%
        .[,2]
      ,names(clist) %>%
        .[str_detect(.,'OV_')] %>%
        str_split_fixed('_',2) %>%
        .[,2]
    )
  )
```

```{r Integrate DEA results to feature data, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 01m 01s
  clist[!(names(clist) %>% str_detect('OV_'))]=
    clist[!(names(clist) %>% str_detect('OV_'))] %>%
    integrate_dea_to_fData(dea_results)
  
  clist=clist %>%
    integrate_dea_to_val(dea_results,disc_val_sets)
  
  saveRDS(clist,'data_pec/clist3_dea.rds')
}else{
  clist=readRDS('data_pec/clist3_dea.rds')
}
```

```{r}
dea_sum_table=
  dea_results %>%
  lapply(X=names(.),Y=.,function(X,Y){
    Y[[X]]$result %>%
      mutate(
        comparison=X
        ,result=
          case_when(
            adj.P.Val>=0.05~'non-DEG'
            ,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC<(-2)~'DEG, log2FC <-2'
            ,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC>=(-2) & logFC<0~'DEG, log2FC -2 to <0'
            ,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC>=0 & logFC<=2~'DEG, log2FC 0 to 2'
            ,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC>2~'DEG, log2FC >2'
          ) %>%
          factor(
            c('DEG, log2FC <-2'
              ,'DEG, log2FC -2 to <0'
              ,'DEG, log2FC 0 to 2'
              ,'DEG, log2FC >2'
              ,'non-DEG'
            )
          )
      ) %>%
      group_by(comparison,result) %>%
      summarize(n=n(),.groups='drop')
  }) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison=
      comparison %>%
      factor(names(dea_results))
  ) %>%
  spread(result,n,fill=0)

dea_sum_table %>%
  knitr::kable() %>%
  kableExtra::kable_classic()
```

```{r}
dea_sum_plot_tab=
  dea_sum_table %>%
  filter(str_detect(comparison,'^OD_C')) %>%
  gather(deg_type,deg_n,-comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    deg_type=
      deg_type %>%
      factor(
        c('DEG, log2FC <-2'
          ,'DEG, log2FC -2 to <0'
          ,'DEG, log2FC 0 to 2'
          ,'DEG, log2FC >2'
          ,'non-DEG'
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  arrange(comparison,deg_type) %>%
  mutate(
    hypertension=
      case_when(
        str_detect(comparison,'PE|GH') & !str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
        ~'Gestational'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'PE|CH') | str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
         ~'Chronic'
        ,TRUE~'None'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('Gestational'
          ,'Chronic'
          ,'None'
        ) %>%
        rev()
      )
    ,onset=
      case_when(
        str_detect(comparison,'_E')~'Early'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'_L')~'Late'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('Early'
          ,'Late'
          ,'NA'
        )
      )
    ,severity=
      case_when(
        str_detect(comparison,'MPE')~'Mild-to-moderate'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'SPE')~'Severe'
        ,TRUE~'N/A'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('Mild-to-moderate'
          ,'Severe'
          ,'N/A'
        )
      )
    ,fgr=
      case_when(
        !str_detect(comparison,'FGR')~'-'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'FGR')~'+'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('-'
          ,'+'
          ,'NA'
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hypertension_severity=
      paste0(hypertension,'|',severity) %>%
      factor(
        c('Gestational|Mild-to-moderate'
          ,'Chronic|Mild-to-moderate'
          ,'None|Mild-to-moderate'
          ,'Gestational|Severe'
          ,'Chronic|Severe'
          ,'None|Severe'
          ,'Gestational|N/A'
          ,'Chronic|N/A'
          ,'None|N/A'
        )
      )
    ,onset_fgr=
      paste0(onset,'|',fgr) %>%
      factor(
        c('Early|-'
          ,'Early|+'
          ,'Early|NA'
          ,'Late|-'
          ,'Late|+'
          ,'Late|NA'
          ,'NA|-'
          ,'NA|+'
          ,'NA|NA'
        )
      )
  )
```

```{r Compute Fisher with Jaccard index, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 02m 11s
```

```{r Summary of overlaps, include=FALSE}
sum_oda_results=
  oda_results %>%
  group_by(A,B) %>%
  summarize(
    overlap=sum(ifelse(overlap=='Not significant',0,1))
    ,.groups='drop'
  ) %>%
  filter(
    A!=B
    & overlap>0
    & str_split_fixed(B,'_',2)[,1]=='OD'
  ) %>%
  select(B,A) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(B,paste0('OD_C_',c(
      'ECH','LCH','EGH','LGH',
      'EOMPE','LOMPE','EOSPE','LOSPE',
      'SIM_EOMPE','SIM_LOMPE','SIM_EOSPE','SIM_LOSPE'
    ))),
    factor(A,c(
      'E_PRE_ESE','E_PRE_MSE','E_PRE_LSE',
      'D_EPND_EPID','D_EPND_IPID','D_EPND_IPCD',
      'P_TE_T1','P_TE_T2',
      'C2_NC2_CHOR2','C3_NC3_CHOR3',
      'H2_NH2_HELLP2','H3_NH3_HELLP3'
    ))
  )
```

```{r Visualize ODA results, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
oda_results %>%
  filter(str_detect(B,'OD_')) %>%
  mutate(
    `Associated factor`=
      trimws(gsub('_',' ',substr(A,3,str_count(A)))) %>%
      factor(c(
        'PRE ESE','PRE MSE','PRE LSE',
        'EPND EPID','EPND IPID','EPND IPCD',
        'TE T1','TE T2',
        'NC2 CHOR2','NC3 CHOR3',
        'NH2 HELLP2','NH3 HELLP3'
      )),
    `Subtype`=
      trimws(gsub('_',' ',str_split_fixed(B,'_',3)[,3])) %>%
      factor(
        rev(c(
          c('ECH','LCH','EGH','LGH',
            'EOMPE','LOMPE','EOSPE','LOSPE',
            'SIM EOMPE','SIM LOMPE','SIM EOSPE','SIM LOSPE'),
          paste(
            c('ECH','LCH','EGH','LGH',
              'EOMPE','LOMPE','EOSPE','LOSPE',
              'SIM EOMPE','SIM LOMPE','SIM EOSPE','SIM LOSPE'),
            'FGR'
          ),
          c('EFGR','LFGR'),
          c('ESE','MSE','LSE'),
          c('EPID','IPID','IPCD'),
          c('T1','T2'),
          c('CHOR2','CHOR3'),
          c('HELLP2','HELLP3')
        ))
      ),
    `Regulation`=
      ifelse(
        overlap=='Not significant'
        ,NA
        ,ifelse(reg.OR>2,2,reg.OR)
      ),
    `Associated factor group`=
      factor(substr(A,1,1),c('E','D','P','C','H')),
    `Subtype group`=
      gsub(' FGR','',`Subtype`) %>%
      factor(c(
        'ECH','LCH','EGH','LGH',
        'EOMPE','LOMPE','EOSPE','LOSPE',
        'SIM EOMPE','SIM LOMPE','SIM EOSPE','SIM LOSPE',
        'EFGR','LFGR',
        'ESE','MSE','LSE',
        'EPID','IPID','IPCD',
        'T1','T2',
        'CHOR2','CHOR3',
        'HELLP2','HELLP3'
      ))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=`Associated factor`,y=`Subtype`,fill=`Regulation`)) +
  geom_tile(color='white') +
  # geom_text(
  #   aes(
  #     label=
  #       ifelse(
  #         overlap=='Not significant'
  #         ,round(size_pass_prop_A*size_pass_prop_B*100)
  #         ,paste0(
  #           round(jaccard*100)
  #           ,ifelse(regulation=='Undifferentiated','','*')
  #         )
  #       )
  #     ,color=
  #       ifelse(
  #         overlap=='Not significant'
  #         ,'A'
  #         ,'B'
  #       ),
  #   ),
  #   size=2,na.rm=TRUE
  # ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label=
        ifelse(
          overlap=='Not significant'  | regulation=='Undifferentiated'
          ,''
          ,'*'
        )
      ,color=
        ifelse(
          overlap=='Not significant'
          ,'A'
          ,'B'
        ),
    ),
    size=2,na.rm=TRUE
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    `Subtype group`~`Associated factor group`
    ,scale='free'
    ,space='free'
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    guide='none'
    ,values=c('black','white')
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    ''
    ,low='darkred',mid='black',high='darkblue',midpoint=1,na.value='darkgrey'
    ,breaks=c(0,0.25,0.5,1,1.25,1.5,2)
    ,labels=c('','','Counterexpression','Undifferentiated','','','Coexpression')
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90,hjust=1,vjust=0.5)
    ,strip.text.y=element_text(angle=0)
  )
```

```{r}
oda_outcome_plot=
  oda_results %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(B,'^OD_')
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_axis=
      case_when(
        str_detect(A,'^E_')
        ~'Endomerial maturation (secretory phase)'
        ,str_detect(A,'^D_')
         ~'Decidualization (implantation site, degree)'
        ,str_detect(A,'^P_')
         ~'Placentation (trimester)'
        ,str_detect(A,'^[:alpha:]+[:digit:]_')
         ~'Comorbidity (trimester)'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate_at(
    c('reg.OR','reg.OR.LB','reg.OR.UB')
    ,\(x) x/(1+x)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    A=case_when(
        A=='E_PRE_ESE'~'Early'
        ,A=='E_PRE_MSE'~'Mid'
        ,A=='E_PRE_LSE'~'Late'
        ,A=='D_EPND_EPID'~'Ectopic, Intermediate'
        ,A=='D_EPND_IPID'~'Intrauterine, Intermediate'
        ,A=='D_EPND_IPCD'~'Intrauterine, Confluent'
        ,A=='P_TE_T1'~'First'
        ,A=='P_TE_T2'~'Second'
        ,A=='C2_NC2_CHOR2'~'Chorioamnionitis, Second'
        ,A=='C3_NC3_CHOR3'~'Chorioamnionitis, Third'
        ,A=='H2_NH2_HELLP2'~'HELLP, Second'
        ,A=='H3_NH3_HELLP3'~'HELLP, Third'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(unique(.))
  ) %>%
  rename(comparison=B) %>%
  mutate(
    hypertension=
      case_when(
        str_detect(comparison,'PE') & str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
        ~'Superimposed PE'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'PE') & !str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
         ~'PE'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'CH') & !str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
         ~'Chronic hyp.'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'GH') & !str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
         ~'Gestational hyp.'
        ,TRUE~'None'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('Superimposed PE'
          ,'PE'
          ,'Chronic hyp.'
          ,'Gestational hyp.'
          ,'None'
        ) %>%
          rev()
      )
    ,onset=
      case_when(
        str_detect(comparison,'_E')~'Early onset'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'_L')~'Late onset'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('Early onset'
          ,'Late onset'
          ,'NA'
        )
      )
    ,severity=
      case_when(
        str_detect(comparison,'MPE')~'Mild-to-\nmoderate'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'SPE')~'Severe'
        ,TRUE~'N/A'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('Severe'
          ,'Mild-to-\nmoderate'
          ,'N/A'
        )
      )
    ,fgr=
      case_when(
        !str_detect(comparison,'FGR')~'FGR (-)'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'FGR')~'FGR (+)'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('FGR (-)'
          ,'FGR (+)'
          ,'NA'
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  rename(B=comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    odeg=
      ifelse(
        overlap=='Not significant'
        ,NA
        ,ifelse(
          regulation=='Undifferentiated'
          ,Ai_Bi
          ,ifelse(
            regulation=='Coexpression'
            ,Au_Bu+Ad_Bd
            ,Ad_Bu+Au_Bd
          )
        )
      )
      
  ) %>%
  group_by(regulation) %>%
  mutate(odeg=odeg/max(odeg,na.rm=T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    regulation=
      ifelse(
        overlap=='Not significant'
        ,NA
        ,case_when(
          regulation=='Undifferentiated'~'~'
          ,regulation=='Coexpression'~'+'
          ,regulation=='Counterexpression'~'-'
          ,TRUE~'NA'
        )
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('~'
          ,'+'
          ,'-'
        )
      )
    ,overlap=
      overlap %>%
      paste0('ly overlapped') %>%
      factor(
        c('Not significantly overlapped'
          ,'Significantly overlapped'
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  lapply(X=unique(pull(.,x_axis)),Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y %>%
      filter(x_axis==X) %>%
      ggplot(aes(A,hypertension)) +
      geom_tile(
        aes(
          fill=overlap
          ,alpha=odeg
        )
        ,color='#ffffffff'
      ) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label=regulation)
        ,color='#000000ff'
        ,size=5
        ,na.rm=T
      ) +
      facet_grid(severity~fgr+onset,scales='free_y',space='free_y') +
      scale_x_discrete(
        X
        ,expand=c(0,0)
      ) +
      scale_y_discrete(
        ''
        ,expand=c(0,0)
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        ''
        ,values=
          c('Not significantly overlapped'='#99999980'
            ,'Significantly overlapped'='#aa9900c0'
          )
        ,breaks=c('Not significantly overlapped','Significantly overlapped')
      ) +
      guides(alpha='none',color='none') +
      theme(
        panel.grid=element_blank()
        # ,panel.spacing=unit(0,'lines')
        # ,panel.border=element_rect(color='#ffffffff')
        ,axis.text.x=
          element_text(size=9,angle=90,hjust=1,vjust=0.5,family='Times New Roman')
        # ,axis.title.x=element_text(size=9,hjust=0.2,family='Times New Roman')
        ,axis.title.x=element_text(size=9,family='Times New Roman')
        ,axis.ticks.y=element_blank()
        ,axis.text.y=element_text(size=9,family='Times New Roman')
        ,axis.title.y=element_text(size=10,family='Times New Roman')
        # ,strip.background.x=element_rect(color=NA,fill='#ffffffff')
        ,strip.text.x=element_text(size=9,family='Times New Roman')
        ,strip.background.y=element_blank()
        ,strip.text.y.right=
          element_text(angle=0,family='Times New Roman')
        ,legend.text=element_text(size=10,family='Times New Roman')
        ,legend.position='top'
      )
  )
```

```{r}
oda_results %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(B,'^OD_')
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_axis=
      case_when(
        str_detect(A,'^E_')
        ~'Endometrial maturation'
        ,str_detect(A,'^D_')
         ~'Decidualization'
        ,str_detect(A,'^P_')
         ~'Placentation'
        ,str_detect(A,'^[:alpha:]+[:digit:]_')
         ~'Comorbidity (placenta)'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(unique(.))
  ) %>%
  rename(comparison=B) %>%
  mutate(
    af=case_when(
        A=='E_PRE_ESE'~'Early'
        ,A=='E_PRE_MSE'~'Mid'
        ,A=='E_PRE_LSE'~'Late'
        ,A=='D_EPND_EPID'~'Ectopic, Intermediate'
        ,A=='D_EPND_IPID'~'Intrauterine, Intermediate'
        ,A=='D_EPND_IPCD'~'Intrauterine, Confluent'
        ,A=='P_TE_T1'~'First'
        ,A=='P_TE_T2'~'Second'
        ,A=='C2_NC2_CHOR2'~'Chorioamnionitis, Second'
        ,A=='C3_NC3_CHOR3'~'Chorioamnionitis, Third'
        ,A=='H2_NH2_HELLP2'~'HELLP, Second'
        ,A=='H3_NH3_HELLP3'~'HELLP, Third'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(unique(.))
    ,hypertension=
      case_when(
        str_detect(comparison,'PE') & str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
        ~'Superimposed PE'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'PE') & !str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
         ~'PE'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'CH') & !str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
         ~'Chronic hypertension'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'GH') & !str_detect(comparison,'SIM')
         ~'Gestational hypertension'
        ,TRUE~''
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('PE'
          ,'Superimposed PE'
          ,'Gestational hypertension'
          ,'Chronic hypertension'
          ,''
        )
      )
    ,onset=
      case_when(
        str_detect(comparison,'_E')~'Early onset'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'_L')~'Late onset'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('Early onset'
          ,'Late onset'
          ,'NA'
        )
      )
    ,severity=
      case_when(
        str_detect(comparison,'MPE')~'mild-to-moderate'
        ,str_detect(comparison,'SPE')~'severe'
        ,TRUE~''
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('mild-to-moderate'
          ,'severe'
          ,''
        )
      )
    ,fgr=
      case_when(
        !str_detect(comparison,'FGR')~''
        ,str_detect(comparison,'FGR')~'FGR'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c(''
          ,'FGR'
          ,'NA'
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate_at(
    c('ovl.OR','ovl.OR.LB','ovl.OR.UB'
      ,'reg.OR','reg.OR.LB','reg.OR.UB'
    )
    ,round,2
  ) %>%
  mutate_at(
    c('ovl.P.Value','reg.P.Value')
    ,\(x)
      ifelse(
        x<0.001
        ,'<0.001'
        ,ifelse(
          x>0.05
          ,'>0.05'
          ,round(x,3)
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  rename(
    ovl.a=Ai_Bi,ovl.b=Ao_Bi,ovl.c=Ai_Bo,ovl.d=Ao_Bo
    ,reg.a=Au_Bu,reg.b=Au_Bd,reg.c=Ad_Bu,reg.d=Ad_Bd
  ) %>%
  unite(ovl.ab,ovl.a,ovl.b,sep='/') %>%
  unite(ovl.cd,ovl.c,ovl.d,sep='/') %>%
  unite(reg.ab,reg.a,reg.b,sep='/') %>%
  unite(reg.cd,reg.c,reg.d,sep='/') %>%
  mutate_at(
    colnames(.) %>%
      .[str_detect(.,'^[:alpha:]+\\.[ac][bd]$')]
    ,\(x)
      paste0('(',x,')')
  ) %>%
  unite(ovl.abcd,ovl.ab,ovl.cd,sep='/') %>%
  unite(reg.abcd,reg.ab,reg.cd,sep='/') %>%
  unite(ovl.OR.CI,ovl.OR.LB,ovl.OR.UB,sep=', ') %>%
  unite(reg.OR.CI,reg.OR.LB,reg.OR.UB,sep=', ') %>%
  # unite(ovl.OR.CI.abcd.P.Value,ovl.OR.CI,ovl.abcd,ovl.P.Value,sep='; ') %>%
  # unite(reg.OR.CI.abcd.P.Value,reg.OR.CI,reg.abcd,reg.P.Value,sep='; ') %>%
  unite(ovl.OR.CI.abcd.P.Value,ovl.OR.CI,ovl.P.Value,sep='; ') %>%
  unite(reg.OR.CI.abcd.P.Value,reg.OR.CI,reg.P.Value,sep='; ') %>%
  mutate_at(
    c('ovl.OR.CI.abcd.P.Value','reg.OR.CI.abcd.P.Value')
    ,\(x)
      paste0('(',x,')')
  ) %>%
  unite(ovl,ovl.OR,ovl.OR.CI.abcd.P.Value,sep=' ') %>%
  unite(reg,reg.OR,reg.OR.CI.abcd.P.Value,sep=' ') %>%
  select(
    x_axis,hypertension,fgr,onset,severity,af
    ,ovl,reg
  ) %>%
  gather(stats,value,-x_axis,-hypertension,-fgr,-onset,-severity,-af) %>%
  mutate(
    stats=
      case_when(
        stats=='ovl'~'Non-RSO'
        ,stats=='reg'~'RSO'
        ,TRUE~'NA'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('Non-RSO'
          ,'RSO'
          ,'NA'
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  arrange(x_axis,hypertension,fgr,onset,severity,stats,af) %>%
  unite(hypertension_fgr,hypertension,fgr,sep=', ') %>%
  unite(onset_severity,onset,severity,sep=', ') %>%
  mutate_at(c('hypertension_fgr','onset_severity'),str_remove_all,'^, |, $') %>%
  mutate_at(
    c('hypertension_fgr')
    ,\(x)
      x %>%
        paste0(' (placenta)')
  ) %>%
  mutate_at(
    c('hypertension_fgr','onset_severity')
    ,\(x)
      x %>%
        factor(unique(.))
  ) %>%
  lapply(X=levels(.$x_axis),Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y %>%
      filter(x_axis==X) %>%
      spread(af,value,fill='-') %>%
      knitr::kable() %>%
      kableExtra::kable_classic()
  )
```

```{r fig.height=3.48, fig.width=5.87}
dea_sum_table %>%
  gather(deg_type,deg_n,-comparison) %>%
  filter(deg_type!='non-DEG') %>%
  mutate_at('deg_type',str_remove_all,'DEG, log2FC ') %>%
  mutate_at('deg_type',str_replace_all,' to ','-') %>%
  mutate(
    tissue=
      comparison %>%
      str_extract_all('^[:alnum:]+') %>%
      unlist()
    ,comparison=
      str_remove_all(comparison,paste0('^',tissue,'_'))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    control=
      comparison %>%
      str_extract_all('^[:alnum:]+') %>%
      unlist()
    ,comparison=
      str_remove_all(comparison,paste0('^',control,'_'))
  ) %>%
  rename(case=comparison) %>%
  mutate_at(
    c('tissue','control')
    ,\(x)
      ifelse(
        str_detect(x,'^[:alpha:]+[:digit:]')
        ,str_remove_all(x,'[:digit:]')
        ,x
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate_at(
    c('tissue','control','case')
    ,\(x)
      x %>%
        factor(unique(.))
  ) %>%
  mutate_at(
    c('deg_type')
    ,\(x)
      x %>%
        factor(
          unique(.) %>%
            rev()
        )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var_type=
      ifelse(
        tissue=='OD'
        ,'The subtype'
        ,'The associated factor'
      )
    ,reg=
      ifelse(
        deg_type%in%c('0-2','>2')
        ,'Upregulated'
        ,'Downregulated'
      ) %>%
      factor(
        c('Upregulated'
          ,'Downregulated'
        )
      )
    ,strength=
      ifelse(
        deg_type%in%c('<-2','>2')
        ,'|logFC|>2'
        ,'|logFC|≤2'
      )
  ) %>%
  group_by(tissue,control,deg_type) %>%
  mutate(
    deg_q=
      (deg_n-mean(deg_n))/sd(deg_n)-ifelse(strength=='|logFC|>2',0.1,-0.1)
  ) %>%
  filter(var_type=='The associated factor') %>%
  filter(tissue%in%c('E','D','P')) %>%
  ggplot(aes(case,deg_q,group=paste0(tissue,deg_type),color=strength)) +
  geom_line(na.rm=T) +
  geom_label(
    aes(label=deg_n)
    ,size=3
    ,label.padding=unit(0.15,'lines')
    ,na.rm=T
    ,show.legend=F
  ) +
  facet_grid(reg~tissue,scales='free') +
  scale_x_discrete(
    ''
    ,expand=c(0.15,0.15)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    ''
    ,expand=c(0.51,0.15)
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid=element_blank()
    ,panel.spacing=unit(0,'lines')
    ,axis.ticks.y=element_blank()
    ,axis.text.y=element_blank()
    ,axis.title.y=element_blank()
  )
```

# Pathway Enrichment Analysis (PEA)

```{r Download the GO from Ensembl, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){ # 09m 45s
  # Downloaded 2023-07-31
  go_evidence=
    getBM(
      mart=ensembl
      ,attributes=c('go_id','go_linkage_type')
    ) %>%
    apply(2,as.character) %>%
    apply(2,trimws) %>%
    apply(2,function(x) gsub('^$|^ $',NA,x)) %>%
    as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors=FALSE) %>%
    filter(!(is.na(go_id) | is.na(go_linkage_type)))
  
  saveRDS(go_evidence,file='data_pec/go_evidence.rds')
}else{
  go_evidence=readRDS(file='data_pec/go_evidence.rds')
```

```{r Meta-code for running alignontology in WSL, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
paste0(
    c('while IFS= read -r line'
      ,'do'
      ,'  line=$(echo "${line}" | sed -e \'s/^[[:space:]]*//\' -e \'s/[[:space:]]*$//\' -e \'s/[[:space:]]\\+/_/g\')'
      ,'  alignontology_0.1/alignOntology \\'
      ,'    "data_pec/alignontology/${line}.txt" \\'
      ,'    "data_pec/alignontology/go.txt" \\'
      ,paste0(
        c('   '
          ,unlist(alignontology[1:5])
          ,'> \\'
        )
        ,collapse=' '
      )
      ,'    "data_pec/alignontology/${line}_alignment.out"'
    )
    ,collapse='\n'
  ) %>%
  c(paste0(
      c('  alignontology_0.1/calculateFDRsForAlignment \\'
        ,'    "data_pec/alignontology/${line}.txt" \\'
        ,'    "data_pec/alignontology/${line}_alignment.out" \\'
        ,'    "data_pec/alignontology/${line}/" \\'
        ,paste0(
          c('   '
            ,unlist(alignontology[6:8])
            ,'> \\'
          )
          ,collapse=' '
        )
        ,'    "data_pec/alignontology/${line}_FDRs.out"'
        ,'done < "data_pec/alignontology/list.txt"'
      )
      ,collapse='\n'
    )
  ) %>%
  paste0(collapse='\n\n') %>%
  cat()
```

```{r}
pathways=list()

pathways$go0=
  pea_results_outcome %>%
  lapply(X=seq(length(.)),Y=.,function(X,Y){
    if(is.null(Y[[X]])){
      NULL
    }else{
      Y[[X]] %>%
        mutate(
          associated_factor=str_split_fixed(names(Y)[X],'\\.',2)[,2]
          ,outcome=str_split_fixed(names(Y)[X],'\\.',2)[,1]
        ) %>%
        rename(reference=go_id) %>%
        select(associated_factor,outcome,reference)
    }
  }) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.)

pathways$cx0=
  ao_results %>%
  lapply(X=seq(length(.)),Y=.,function(X,Y){
    if(is.null(Y[[X]])){
      NULL
    }else{
      Y[[X]] %>%
        mutate(
          associated_factor=str_split_fixed(names(Y)[X],'\\.',2)[,2]
          ,outcome=str_split_fixed(names(Y)[X],'\\.',2)[,1]
        ) %>%
        select(associated_factor,outcome,reference,computed)
    }
  }) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.)

pathways$go0=
  pathways$go0 %>%
  lapply(
    X=select(.,associated_factor,outcome) %>%
      .[!duplicated(.),] %>%
      nrow() %>%
      seq()
    ,Y=
      select(.,associated_factor,outcome) %>%
      .[!duplicated(.),]
    ,Z=.
    ,K=pathways$cx
    ,function(X,Y,Z,K){
      L=filter(Z,associated_factor==Y$associated_factor[X] & outcome==Y$outcome[X])
      M=filter(K,associated_factor==Y$associated_factor[X] & outcome==Y$outcome[X])
      left_join(L,M,by=c('associated_factor','outcome','reference'))
    }
  ) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.)

pathways$go=
  pathways$go0 %>%
  mutate(
    associated_factor=factor(associated_factor,unique(associated_factor))
    ,outcome=factor(outcome,unique(outcome))
  ) %>%
  group_by(associated_factor,outcome) %>%
  summarize(n=n(),.groups='drop') %>%
  mutate(method='GSEA, GO')

pathways$cx2=
  pathways$cx0 %>%
  mutate(
    associated_factor=factor(associated_factor,unique(associated_factor))
    ,outcome=factor(outcome,unique(outcome))
  ) %>%
  group_by(associated_factor,outcome) %>%
  summarize(n=sum(!is.na(reference)),.groups='drop') %>%
  mutate(method='DDOI, Aligned to GO')

pathways$cx=
  pathways$cx0 %>%
  mutate(
    associated_factor=factor(associated_factor,unique(associated_factor))
    ,outcome=factor(outcome,unique(outcome))
  ) %>%
  group_by(associated_factor,outcome) %>%
  summarize(n=sum(is.na(reference)),.groups='drop') %>%
  mutate(method='DDOI, Not aligned to GO')
```

```{r}
pathways$go0 %>%
  rbind(pathways$cx0) %>%
  mutate(
    reference=
      ifelse(
        is.na(reference) & !is.na(computed)
        ,computed
        ,reference
      )
  ) %>%
  group_by(associated_factor,outcome,reference) %>%
  mutate(
    computed=
      computed %>%
      .[!is.na(.)] %>%
      paste0(collapse='|')
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method=
      case_when(
        str_detect(reference,'GO\\:')&computed==''~'GSEA'
        ,str_detect(reference,'GO\\:')&str_detect(computed,'CliXO\\:')~'GSEA+DDOI'
        ,str_detect(reference,'CliXO\\:')~'DDOI'
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    associated_factor=factor(associated_factor,unique(associated_factor))
    ,outcome=factor(outcome,unique(outcome))
  ) %>%
  group_by(associated_factor,outcome,method) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome=
      str_remove_all(outcome,'OD_C_') %>%
      str_replace_all('_',' ')
    ,tissue=
      str_remove_all(str_split_fixed(associated_factor,'_',2)[,1],'[:digit:]')
    ,associated_factor=
      str_split_fixed(associated_factor,'_',2)[,2] %>%
      str_replace_all('_',' ')
    ,associated_factor=paste0(tissue,': ',associated_factor)
    ,associated_factor=
      associated_factor %>%
      factor(c(
        'E: PRE ESE'
        ,'E: PRE MSE'
        ,'E: PRE LSE'
        ,'D: EPND EPID'
        ,'D: EPND IPID'
        ,'D: EPND IPCD'
        ,'P: TE T1'
        ,'P: TE T2'
        ,'C: NC2 CHOR2'
        ,'C: NC3 CHOR3'
        ,'H: NH2 HELLP2'
        ,'H: NH3 HELLP3'
      ))
    ,outcome=
      outcome %>%
      factor(rev(c(
        'ECH FGR'
        ,'LCH FGR'
        ,'EGH'
        ,'EOMPE FGR'
        ,'LOMPE FGR'
        ,'EOSPE'
        ,'EOSPE FGR'
        ,'LOSPE'
        ,'LOSPE FGR'
        ,'SIM EOSPE'
        ,'SIM EOSPE FGR'
      )))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=associated_factor,y=outcome,fill=n)) +
  geom_tile(color='white') +
  geom_text(aes(label=n),size=3,color='white',na.rm=T) +
  facet_wrap(~method,scales='free_x') +
  scale_x_discrete('Associated factor') +
  scale_y_discrete('Outcome') +
  scale_color_discrete('Method') +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    '# pathways'
    ,low='darkred',mid='black',high='darkblue',midpoint=25,na.value='darkgrey'
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90,hjust=1,vjust=0.5)
  )
```

```{r DI-VNN feature selection and representation, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){
  for(ontoclass in c('pea','cx')){
    
    if(ontoclass=='pea'){
      X=avail_ovl_pea
    }else{
      X=avail_ovl_cx
    }
    
    for(x in X){
      
      cat(paste0(ontoclass,':',which(X==x),'/',length(X)),'\n')
      
      input=list()
      
      input$value=
        onebitsgd_results %>%
        .[[x]] %>%
        t() %>%
        as.data.frame()
      
      input$outcome=
        clist %>%
        .[[str_split_fixed(x,'\\.',2)[,1]]] %>%
        pData() %>%
        mutate(outcome=as.integer(outcome==levels(outcome)[2])) %>%
        pull(outcome) %>%
        setNames(rownames(input$value))
      
      input$similarity=
        pear_cor_mats %>%
        .[[x]]
      
      input$mapping=
        tsne_results %>%
        .[[x]]
      
      if(ontoclass=='pea'){
        input$ontology=
          pea_results_outcome %>%
          .[x] %>%
          pea_to_mapping(clist) %>%
          .[[1]] %>%
          select(source=feature,target=oid) %>%
          mutate(similarity=NA,relation='feature') %>%
          rbind(
            pea_results_outcome %>%
              .[x] %>%
              lapply(pea_to_hierarchy) %>%
              .[[1]] %>%
              select(source=from,target=to) %>%
              mutate(similarity=NA,relation='is_a')
          ) %>%
          mutate(target=ifelse(target=='root','ONT:0',target))
      }else{
        input$ontology=
          cx_results %>%
          .[[x]]
      }
      
      input$ontology=
        input$ontology %>%
        mutate(seq=seq(nrow(.))) %>%
        gather(key,value,-similarity,-relation,-seq) %>%
        mutate(
          value2=
            ifelse(
              str_detect(value,'[:alpha:]+\\:')
              ,str_remove_all(value,'[:alpha:]+\\:')
              ,NA
            ) %>%
            as.integer()
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          value3=
            ifelse(
              str_detect(value,'[:alpha:]+\\:')
              ,paste0(
                'ONT:'
                ,str_pad(value2,str_count(max(value2,na.rm=T)),'left','0')
              )
              ,value
            )
        )
      
      if(!dir.exists('data_pec/divnn_models/ontology')){
        dir.create('data_pec/divnn_models/ontology',recursive=T)
      }
      
      input$ontology %>%
        select(value,value3) %>%
        filter(str_detect(value,'[:alpha:]+\\:')) %>%
        filter(!duplicated(.)) %>%
        rename(old_oid=value,new_oid=value3) %>%
        write_csv(paste0('data_pec/divnn_models/ontology','/',x,'_',ontoclass,'.csv'))
      
      input$ontology=
        input$ontology %>%
        mutate(value=value3) %>%
        select(-value2,-value3) %>%
        spread(key,value) %>%
        arrange(seq) %>%
        select(-seq) %>%
        select(source,target,everything())
      
      input$fit=
        clist %>%
        .[[str_split_fixed(x,'\\.',2)[,1]]] %>%
        fData() %>%
        .[,c('logFC','AveExpr','t','P.Value','adj.P.Val','B')]
      
      output=
        TidySet.compile(
          value=input$value
          ,outcome=input$outcome
          ,similarity=input$similarity
          ,mapping=input$mapping
          ,ontology=input$ontology
          ,ranked=T
          ,dims=224
          ,decreasing=F
          ,seed_num=seed
        )
      
      output %>%
        TidySet.write(
          paste0('data_pec/divnn_models','/',x,'_',ontoclass,'_target')
        )
    }
    
  }
}
```

```{r Choose the best L2-norm regularization factors, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){
  best_l2_norm=
    list.files('data_pec/divnn_models',full.names=T,recursive=T) %>%
    .[str_detect(.,'ontonet_tuning')] %>%
    .[str_detect(.,'history\\.csv')] %>%
    `names<-`(
      str_remove_all(
        .
        ,'data_pec/divnn_models/|_ontonet_tuning|/history\\.csv'
      )
    ) %>%
    lapply(read_csv,show_col_types=F) %>%
    lapply(X=names(.),Y=.,\(X,Y)mutate(Y[[X]],file=X)) %>%
    do.call(rbind,.) %>%
    select(file,everything()) %>%
    separate(file,c('model','hyperparameter'),sep='/') %>%
    inner_join(
      list.files('data_pec/divnn_models',full.names=T,recursive=T) %>%
        .[str_detect(.,'ontonet_tuning')] %>%
        .[str_detect(.,'\\.pt')] %>%
        data.frame(file=.) %>%
        mutate(
          file=
            file %>%
            str_remove_all(
              'data_pec/divnn_models/|_ontonet_tuning|/\\.pt'
            )
        ) %>%
        separate(file,c('model','hyperparameter','epoch'),sep='/') %>%
        filter(epoch!='null.pt') %>%
        mutate(
          epoch=
            epoch %>%
            str_remove_all('\\.pt') %>%
            as.numeric()
        ) %>%
        group_by(model,hyperparameter) %>%
        filter(epoch==max(epoch))
      ,by=c('model','hyperparameter','epoch')
    ) %>%
    filter(subset=='validation') %>%
    select(-subset) %>%
    group_by(model) %>%
    filter(roc_auc==max(roc_auc)) %>%
    filter(
      as.numeric(
        hyperparameter %>%
          str_remove_all('l2_norm_')
      )==min(
        as.numeric(
          hyperparameter %>%
            str_remove_all('l2_norm_')
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    lapply(X=1,Y=.,\(X,Y)
      list(
          Y
          ,Y %>%
            mutate(
              training_tidy_set_file=
                model %>%
                paste0('_target')
              ,training_tidy_set_file=
                paste0(
                  'data\\divnn_models\\'
                  ,training_tidy_set_file
                  ,'.ts.tar.gz'
                )
              ,l2_norm=
                hyperparameter %>%
                str_remove_all('l2_norm_') %>%
                as.numeric()
            ) %>%
            select(training_tidy_set_file,l2_norm) %>%
            write_csv('data_pec/divnn_models/best_l2_norm.csv')
        ) %>%
        .[[1]]
    ) %>%
    .[[1]]
  
  saveRDS(best_l2_norm,'data_pec/best_l2_norm.rds')
}else{
```

```{r DI-VNN feature selection and representation validation, include=FALSE}
if(all(c(1,2)%in%comp_req)){
  for(ontoclass in c('pea','cx')){
    
    if(ontoclass=='pea'){
      X=avail_ovl_pea
    }else{
      X=avail_ovl_cx
    }
    
    for(i in seq(length(X))){
      x=X[i]
      y=X[i] %>%
        str_replace_all('^OD_','OV_')
      
      cat(paste0(ontoclass,':',which(X==x),'/',length(X)),'\n')
      
      input=list()
      
      input$value=
        onebitsgd_results_val %>%
        .[[y]] %>%
        t() %>%
        as.data.frame()
      
      input$outcome=
        clist %>%
        .[[str_split_fixed(y,'\\.',2)[,1]]] %>%
        pData() %>%
        mutate(outcome=as.integer(outcome==levels(outcome)[2])) %>%
        pull(outcome) %>%
        setNames(rownames(input$value))
      
      input$similarity=
        pear_cor_mats %>%
        .[[x]]
      
      input$mapping=
        tsne_results %>%
        .[[x]]
      
      if(ontoclass=='pea'){
        input$ontology=
          pea_results_outcome %>%
          .[x] %>%
          pea_to_mapping(clist) %>%
          .[[1]] %>%
          select(source=feature,target=oid) %>%
          mutate(similarity=NA,relation='feature') %>%
          rbind(
            pea_results_outcome %>%
              .[x] %>%
              lapply(pea_to_hierarchy) %>%
              .[[1]] %>%
              select(source=from,target=to) %>%
              mutate(similarity=NA,relation='is_a')
          ) %>%
          mutate(target=ifelse(target=='root','ONT:0',target))
      }else{
        input$ontology=
          cx_results %>%
          .[[x]]
      }
      
      input$ontology=
        input$ontology %>%
        mutate(seq=seq(nrow(.))) %>%
        gather(key,value,-similarity,-relation,-seq) %>%
        mutate(
          value2=
            ifelse(
              str_detect(value,'[:alpha:]+\\:')
              ,str_remove_all(value,'[:alpha:]+\\:')
              ,NA
            ) %>%
            as.integer()
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          value3=
            ifelse(
              str_detect(value,'[:alpha:]+\\:')
              ,paste0(
                'ONT:'
                ,str_pad(value2,str_count(max(value2,na.rm=T)),'left','0')
              )
              ,value
            )
        )
      
      input$ontology=
        input$ontology %>%
        mutate(value=value3) %>%
        select(-value2,-value3) %>%
        spread(key,value) %>%
        arrange(seq) %>%
        select(-seq) %>%
        select(source,target,everything())
      
      input$fit=
        clist %>%
        .[[str_split_fixed(y,'\\.',2)[,1]]] %>%
        fData() %>%
        .[,c('logFC','AveExpr','t','P.Value','adj.P.Val','B')]
      
      output=
        TidySet.compile(
          value=input$value
          ,outcome=input$outcome
          ,similarity=input$similarity
          ,mapping=input$mapping
          ,ontology=input$ontology
          ,ranked=T
          ,dims=224
          ,decreasing=F
          ,seed_num=seed
        )
      
      if(!dir.exists('data_pec/divnn_models/validation')){
        dir.create('data_pec/divnn_models/validation',recursive=T)
      }
      
      output %>%
        TidySet.write(
          paste0('data_pec/divnn_models/validation','/',x,'_',ontoclass,'_target')
        )
    }
    
  }
}
```

```{r}
calibration=
  function(
    eval_df
    ,boot=30
  ){
    eval_df_bin=
      eval_df %>%
      mutate(pred=round(pred,1))
    
    calib_plot_df=
      eval_df_bin %>%
      group_by(pred) %>%
      summarize(
        true=mean(obs==levels(obs)[2])
        ,se=qnorm(0.975)*sd(obs==levels(obs)[2])/sqrt(n())
        ,lb=true-se
        ,ub=true+se
      )
    
    calib_plot=
      calib_plot_df %>%
      ggplot(aes(pred,true)) +
      geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,lty=2) +
      geom_linerange(aes(ymin=lb,ymax=ub)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_smooth(method='lm',formula=y~x,color='black',na.rm=T) +
      coord_equal() +
      scale_x_continuous(limits=0:1,breaks=seq(0,1,0.1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits=0:1,breaks=seq(0,1,0.1)) +
      theme_classic()
    
    calib_dist=
      eval_df_bin %>%
      group_by(obs,pred) %>%
      summarize(n=n(),.groups='drop') %>%
      ggplot(aes(pred,n)) +
      geom_col(width=0.075,) +
      facet_grid(obs~.,scales='free_y') +
      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-0.1,1.1),breaks=seq(0,1,0.1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(trans='log10') +
      theme_classic()
    
    set.seed(1)
    calib_metrics=
      calib_plot_df %>%
      lm(true~pred,data=.) %>%
      tidy() %>%
      mutate(term=c('intercept','slope')) %>%
      mutate(ci=qnorm(0.975)*std.error) %>%
      select(-std.error,-statistic,-p.value) %>%
      rbind(
        eval_df %>%
        mutate(sqr_error=(pred-as.integer(obs==levels(obs)[2]))^2) %>%
        pull(sqr_error) %>%
        sapply(X=seq(boot),Y=.,function(X,Y)
          Y %>%
            .[sample(seq(length(.)),length(.),T)] %>%
            mean() %>%
            sqrt()
        ) %>%
        data.frame(term='rmse',rmse=.) %>%
        group_by(term) %>%
        summarize(
          estimate=mean(rmse)
          ,ci=qnorm(0.975)*sd(rmse)/sqrt(n())
          ,.groups='drop'
        )
      )
    
    list(
      plot=calib_plot
      ,dist=calib_dist
      ,metrics=calib_metrics
    )
  }
```

```{r}
discrimination=
  function(
    eval_df
    ,boot=30
  ){
    source('pec_R/compute_metrics-function.R')
    
    disc_plot=
      eval_df %>%
      compute_metrics(p=F,ppv=F,npv=F,nb=F,interp=F) %>%
      .$metrics %>%
      select(th,tpr,tnr) %>%
      ggplot(aes(tnr,tpr)) +
      geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=1,lty=2) +
      geom_path() +
      geom_point() +
      geom_text(
        aes(label=round(th,2))
        ,hjust=-0.1
        ,vjust=1.1
        ,size=3
        ,check_overlap=T
      ) +
      coord_equal() +
      scale_x_reverse(breaks=seq(0,1,0.1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,0.1)) +
      theme_classic()
    
    set.seed(1)
    disc_metrics=
      seq(boot) %>%
      lapply(function(x){
        eval_df %>%
          .[sample(seq(nrow(.)),nrow(.),T),] %>%
          compute_metrics(p=F,ppv=F,npv=F,nb=F,interp=F) %>%
          .$metrics %>%
          mutate(boot=x)
      }) %>%
      do.call(rbind,.) %>%
      select(-th) %>%
      group_by(boot) %>%
      arrange(tnr,tpr) %>%
      mutate(seq=seq(n())) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      rename(x=tnr,y=tpr) %>%
      left_join(
        slice(.,-1) %>%
          mutate(seq=seq-1) %>%
          rename(x2=x,y2=y)
        ,by=c('boot','seq')
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        auc=
          0.5*(x2-x)*(y-y2)+
          (x2-x)*y2
      ) %>%
      group_by(boot) %>%
      summarize(auc=sum(auc,na.rm=T),.groups='drop') %>%
      summarize(
        term='AUC-ROC'
        ,estimate=mean(auc)
        ,ci=qnorm(0.975)*sd(auc)/sqrt(n())
      )
    
    list(
      plot=disc_plot
      ,metrics=disc_metrics
    )
  }
```

```{r}
    )
```
