```{r}
thresholding=
  function(
    eval_df
    ,standard=T
    ,optimal=T
    ,clinical=T
    ,custom_metric=NULL
    ,custom_ref=NULL
    ,boot=30
  ){
    source('pec_R/compute_metrics-function.R')
    
    set.seed(1)
    cm_metrics=
      seq(boot) %>%
      lapply(function(x){
        eval_df %>%
          .[sample(seq(nrow(.)),nrow(.),T),] %>%
          compute_metrics(p=F,interp=F) %>%#T) %>%
          .$metrics
      }) %>%
      do.call(rbind,.)
    
    thresholds=list()
    
    if(standard){
      thresholds$standard=
        cm_metrics %>%
        filter(th==0.5) %>%
        gather(metric,value,-th) %>%
        mutate(ref_type='Threshold') %>%
        rename(ref_value=th) %>%
        select(ref_type,everything())
    }
    
    if(optimal){
      thresholds$optimal=
        cm_metrics %>%
        mutate(avg_acc=(tpr+tnr)/2) %>%
        filter(avg_acc==max(avg_acc)) %>%
        gather(metric,value,-avg_acc) %>%
        mutate(ref_type='(TPR+TNR)/2') %>%
        rename(ref_value=avg_acc) %>%
        select(ref_type,everything())
    }
    
    if(clinical){
      thresholds$clinical=
        cm_metrics %>%
        filter(tnr==0.9) %>%
        gather(metric,value,-tnr) %>%
        mutate(ref_type='TNR') %>%
        rename(ref_value=tnr) %>%
        select(ref_type,everything())
    }
    
    if(!is.null(custom_metric) & !is.null(custom_ref)){
      thresholds$custom=
        cm_metrics %>%
        rename_at(custom_metric,function(x)'custom_metric') %>%
        filter(custom_metric==custom_ref) %>%
        gather(metric,value,-custom_metric) %>%
        rename(ref_value=custom_metric) %>%
        mutate(ref_type=str_to_upper(custom_metric)) %>%
        select(ref_type,everything())
    }
    
    thresholds %>%
      do.call(rbind,.) %>%
      group_by(ref_type,ref_value,metric) %>%
      summarize(
        avg=mean(value)
        ,lb=mean(value)-qnorm(0.975)*sd(value)/sqrt(n())
        ,ub=mean(value)+qnorm(0.975)*sd(value)/sqrt(n())
        ,.groups='drop'
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        avg=
          ifelse(
            metric%in%c('th','nb')
            ,round(avg,2)
            ,round(avg*100,2)
          )
        ,lb=
          ifelse(
            metric%in%c('th','nb')
            ,round(lb,2)
            ,round(lb*100,2)
          )
        ,ub=
          ifelse(
            metric%in%c('th','nb')
            ,round(ub,2)
            ,round(ub*100,2)
          )
      )
  }
```

```{r}
causal_prob=
  function(
    inference_model
    ,threshold
    ,train_data
    ,outcome_name='outcome'
  ){
    outcome=
      train_data %>%
      pull(outcome_name)
    
    inference_data=
      inference_model %>%
      predict(train_data,type='response') %>%
      data.frame(pred=.) %>%
      mutate(
        pred=
          ifelse(
            pred>=threshold
            ,levels(outcome)[2]
            ,levels(outcome)[1]
          ) %>%
          factor(levels=levels(outcome))
      ) %>%
      cbind(train_data) %>%
      select_at(colnames(.) %>% .[.!=outcome_name]) %>%
      rename_at('pred',function(x)outcome_name)
    
    get_counterfactual=
      function(
        predictor_name
        ,outcome_name
        ,inference_data
      ){
        predictor=
          inference_data %>%
          pull(predictor_name)
        
        outcome=
          inference_data %>%
          pull(outcome_name)
        
        if(is.factor(predictor)){
          reference=levels(predictor)[1]
          interest=levels(predictor)[-1]
          
          inference=list()
          
          inference$sufficiency$factual=
            inference_data %>%
            filter_at(predictor_name,function(x)x==reference) %>%
            filter_at(outcome_name,function(x)x==levels(outcome)[1])
          
          inference$sufficiency$counterfactual=
            interest %>%
            lapply(function(x)
              inference$sufficiency$factual %>%
                mutate_at(
                  predictor_name
                  ,function(y)factor(x,levels=levels(predictor))
                ) %>%
                mutate_at(
                  outcome_name
                  ,function(y)NA
                ) %>%
                mutate(term=x)
            ) %>%
            do.call(rbind,.)
          
          inference$sufficiency$factual=
            interest %>%
            lapply(function(x)
              inference$sufficiency$factual %>%
                mutate(term=x)
            ) %>%
            do.call(rbind,.)
            inference_data %>%
            filter_at(predictor_name,function(x)x==reference) %>%
            filter_at(outcome_name,function(x)x==levels(outcome)[1]) %>%
            mutate(term=reference)
          
          inference$necessity$factual=
            interest %>%
            lapply(function(x)
              inference_data %>%
                filter_at(predictor_name,function(y)y==x) %>%
                filter_at(outcome_name,function(y)y==levels(outcome)[2]) %>%
                mutate(term=x)
            ) %>%
            do.call(rbind,.)
          
          inference$necessity$counterfactual=
            interest %>%
            lapply(function(x)
              inference$necessity$factual %>%
                filter_at(predictor_name,function(y)y==x) %>%
                mutate_at(
                  predictor_name
                  ,function(x)factor(reference,levels=levels(predictor))
                ) %>%
                mutate_at(
                  outcome_name
                  ,function(x)NA
                ) %>%
                mutate(term=x)
            ) %>%
            do.call(rbind,.)
        }else if(is.numeric(predictor)){
          predictor_scaler=
            inference_data %>%
            filter(outcome==levels(outcome)[1]) %>%
            mutate(seq=seq(nrow(.))) %>%
            select_at(c('seq',predictor_name)) %>%
            gather(variable,value,-seq) %>%
            group_by(variable) %>%
            summarize(
              q1=quantile(value,0.25)
              ,q3=quantile(value,0.75)
              ,iqr=q3-q1
              ,avg=mean(ifelse(value<(q1-1.5*iqr) | value>(q3+1.5*iqr),NA,value),na.rm=T)
              ,std=sd(ifelse(value<(q1-1.5*iqr) | value>(q3+1.5*iqr),NA,value),na.rm=T)
              ,lb=avg-qnorm(0.975)*std
              ,ub=avg+qnorm(0.975)*std
              ,lb=round(lb,2)
              ,ub=round(ub,2)
              ,.groups='drop'
            )
          
          predictor_factor=
            inference_data %>%
            filter(outcome==levels(outcome)[1]) %>%
            mutate(seq=seq(nrow(.))) %>%
            select_at(c('seq',predictor_name)) %>%
            gather(variable,value,-seq) %>%
            left_join(predictor_scaler,by='variable') %>%
            mutate(
              value2=
                factor(
                  ifelse(
                    value>=lb & value<=ub
                    ,'normal'#paste0('value>=',lb[1],' & value<=',ub[1],'')
                    ,'abnormal'#paste0('value<',lb[1],' & value>',ub[1],'')
                  )
                  ,levels=
                    c('normal'#paste0('value>=',lb[1],' & value<=',ub[1],'')
                      ,'abnormal'#paste0('value<',lb[1],' & value>',ub[1],'')
                      )
                )
            ) %>%
            select(seq,variable,value2) %>%
            spread(variable,value2) %>%
            select(-seq) %>%
            pull(1)
          
          reference=
            which(predictor_factor==levels(predictor_factor)[1]) %>%
            intersect(which(outcome==levels(outcome)[1]))
          interest=
            which(predictor_factor==levels(predictor_factor)[2]) %>%
            intersect(which(outcome==levels(outcome)[2]))
          
          inference=list()
          
          inference$sufficiency$factual=
            inference_data %>%
            slice(reference) %>%
            mutate(term=levels(predictor_factor)[2])
          
          inference$sufficiency$counterfactual=
            inference$sufficiency$factual %>%
            mutate_at(
              predictor_name
              ,function(y)y+ifelse(y>=0,1,-1)*qnorm(0.975)*predictor_scaler$std
            ) %>%
            mutate_at(
              outcome_name
              ,function(y)NA
            ) %>%
            mutate(term=levels(predictor_factor)[2])
          
          inference$necessity$factual=
            inference_data %>%
            slice(interest) %>%
            mutate(term=levels(predictor_factor)[2])
          
          inference$necessity$counterfactual=
            inference$necessity$factual %>%
            mutate_at(
              predictor_name
              ,function(y)y+ifelse(y>=0,-1,1)*qnorm(0.975)*predictor_scaler$std
            ) %>%
            mutate_at(
              outcome_name
              ,function(y)NA
            ) %>%
            mutate(term=levels(predictor_factor)[2])
        }
        
        inference %>%
          lapply(X=names(.),Y=.,function(X,Y)
            Y[[X]] %>%
              lapply(X=names(.),Y=.,Z=X,function(X,Y,Z)
                Y[[X]] %>%
                  mutate(
                    prob=Z
                    ,type=X
                  )
              ) %>%
              do.call(rbind,.)
          ) %>%
          do.call(rbind,.) %>%
          mutate(predictor_name=predictor_name) %>%
          select(predictor_name,prob,type,term,everything())
      }
    
    inference_results=
      inference_data %>%
      colnames() %>%
      .[.!=outcome_name] %>%
      lapply(get_counterfactual,outcome_name,inference_data) %>%
      do.call(rbind,.)
    
    counterfactuals=
      inference_results %>%
      pull(outcome) %>%
      is.na() %>%
      which()
    
    inference_results$outcome[counterfactuals]=
      inference_model %>%
      predict(
        inference_results[counterfactuals,]
        ,type='response'
      ) %>%
      data.frame(pred=.) %>%
      mutate(
        pred=
          ifelse(
            pred>=threshold
            ,levels(outcome)[2]
            ,levels(outcome)[1]
          ) %>%
          factor(levels=levels(outcome))
      ) %>%
      pull(pred)
    
    inference_results %>%
      group_by_at(c('predictor_name','prob','type','term',outcome_name)) %>%
      summarize(n=n(),.groups='drop') %>%
      spread(type,n,fill=0) %>%
      filter(factual!=0) %>%
      select_at(colnames(.) %>% .[.!=outcome_name]) %>%
      mutate(value=(factual-counterfactual)/factual) %>%
      unite(value_counterfactual_factual,value,counterfactual,factual,sep='|') %>%
      spread(prob,value_counterfactual_factual) %>%
      separate(
        necessity
        ,paste0('necessity_',c('prob','cf','f'))
        ,sep='\\|'
      ) %>%
      separate(
        sufficiency
        ,paste0('sufficiency_',c('prob','cf','f'))
        ,sep='\\|'
      ) %>%
      mutate_if(!colnames(.)%in%c('predictor_name','term'),as.numeric)
  }
```

```{r include=FALSE}
        model
        ,ontology
      )
  ) %>%
  filter(set=='validation') %>%
  unite(ci,lb,ub,sep=', ') %>%
  mutate(
    ci=
      ci %>%
      map_chr(~paste0('(',.,')'))
  ) %>%
  unite(value,avg,ci,sep=' ') %>%
  mutate(
    model=
      model %>%
      factor(unique(.))
    ,ontology=
      ontology %>%
      factor(unique(.))
    ,metric=
      ifelse(
        metric%in%c('ppv','npv')
        ,'pv'
        ,'tr'
      )
  ) %>%
  spread(metric,value)

selection_ao=
  selection_ao %>%
  lapply(X=.$model %>% unique(),Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y %>%
      filter(model==X) %>%
      select(
        old_oid,ontology,pv,tr
        ,reference,similarity,termin_nodes
        ,term,definition,common_termin
      )
  ) %>%
  `names<-`(
    selection_ao %>%
      .$model %>%
      unique()
  ) %>%
  .[sapply(.,\(x)nrow(x)>0)]
```

```{r include=FALSE}
best_divnn_grad_cam=
  list.files('data_pec/divnn_models',full.names=T,recursive=T) %>%
  .[str_detect(.,'_ontonet/')] %>%
  .[str_detect(.,'[:digit:]+\\.pt')] %>%
  lapply(
    X=str_remove_all(.,'[:digit:]+\\.pt') %>%
      unique()
    ,Y=.
    ,\(X,Y)
      Y %>%
        .[str_detect(.,X)]
  ) %>%
  setNames(
    lapply(.,str_remove_all,'[:digit:]+\\.pt') %>%
      sapply(unique) %>%
      str_remove_all('data_pec/divnn_models/|_ontonet/')
  ) %>%
  sapply(\(x)
    x %>%
      .[which.max(
          str_extract_all(.,'/[:digit:]+\\.pt') %>%
            sapply(\(x)str_remove_all(x,'/|\\.pt')) %>%
            as.numeric()
        )
      ] %>%
      str_replace_all('\\.pt','.csv')
  ) %>%
  pblapply(read_csv,show_col_types=F) %>%
  lapply(mutate_at,c('x','y','z'),\(x)x+1) %>%
  .[names(divnn_ontotype)] %>%
  pblapply(X=names(.),Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y[[X]] %>%
      left_join(
        divnn_ontotype[[X]] %>%
          mutate_at(c('x','y','z'),as.numeric)
        ,by=c('ontology','x','y','z')
      ) %>%
      mutate(model=X) %>%
      select(model,everything())
  ) %>%
  lapply(X=1,Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y %>%
      pblapply(
        left_join
        ,Y %>%
          do.call(rbind,.) %>%
          pull(feature) %>%
          .[!is.na(.)] %>%
          unique() %>%
          data.frame(feature=.) %>%
          mutate(
            code=
              paste0(
                'F'
                ,str_pad(seq(n()),str_count(n()),'left','0')
              )
          )
        ,by='feature'
      )
  ) %>%
  .[[1]] %>%
  `names<-`(names(divnn_ontotype)) %>%
  pblapply(X=names(.),Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y[[X]] %>%
      filter(
        ontology
        %in%selection_ao[[X]]$ontology
      ) %>%
      mutate(model=X) %>%
      select(model,everything()) %>%
      left_join(
        divnn_ontology_names[[X]] %>%
          rbind(
            data.frame(
              old_oid='root'
              ,new_oid='root'
            )
          ) %>%
          rename(ontology=new_oid) %>%
          mutate(
            ontology=
              ontology %>%
              str_remove_all('\\:')
          )
        ,by=
          join_by(
            ontology
          )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        ontology=
          old_oid %>%
          factor(unique(.))
      ) %>%
      select(-old_oid)
  ) %>%
  `names<-`(names(divnn_ontotype))
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# Obtained at 2024/04/29
# Using https://gsai.ideker.ucsd.edu/
divnn_ont_grad_cam_gsai=
  read_csv('data_pec/gsai_result.csv',show_col_types=F) %>%
  mutate(
    result=
      result %>%
      str_replace_all(
        "I'm sorry, but I need more information to provide a detailed analysis. "
        ,'Process: Unknown (0.00)\n\n'
      )
  ) %>%
  select(-date) %>%
  mutate(seq=seq(n())) %>%
  select(seq,everything()) %>%
  lapply(X=seq(nrow(.)),Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y[X,,drop=F] %>%
      select(-result) %>%
      cbind(
        Y$result[X] %>%
          str_extract_all('.*') %>%
          .[[1]] %>%
          .[.!=''] %>%
          data.frame(result=.)
      )
  ) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.) %>%
  mutate(
    type=
      case_when(
        str_detect(result,'^Process\\:')~'name_score'
        ,TRUE~'description'
      )
  ) %>%
  lapply(X=1,Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y %>%
      filter(type=='name_score') %>%
      spread(type,result) %>%
      left_join(
        Y %>%
          filter(type=='description') %>%
          select(-type)
        ,by=
          join_by(
            seq
            ,model
            ,ontology
            ,query
          )
      )
  ) %>%
  .[[1]] %>%
  select(-seq) %>%
  mutate_all(\(x)ifelse(x=='NA',NA,x)) %>%
  mutate(
    name_score=
      name_score %>%
      str_replace_all('\\(cGMP\\)','cGMP') %>%
      str_replace_all('\\(Src-like-adaptor\\)','Src-like-adaptor')
  ) %>%
  separate(name_score,c('name','score'),sep=' \\(') %>%
  mutate(
    name=
      name %>%
      str_remove_all('Process\\: ')
    ,score=
      score %>%
      str_remove_all('\\)') %>%
      as.numeric()
  ) %>%
  select(model,ontology,gene_set=query,name,score,everything())
```

```{r table-1, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
  unite(B,B1,B2,sep=': ') %>%
  mutate(
    B=B %>%
      factor(unique(.))
  ) %>%
  `colnames<-`(
    c('B'
      ,'Tissue'
      ,'Condition'
      ,'features'
    )
  ) %>%
  spread(B,features,fill=0) %>%
  write_csv('table1.csv')
```

```{r include=FALSE}
pipeline_results=
  list(
    `Gene set`=
      c(avail_ovl %>%
          paste0('_pea')
        ,avail_ovl %>%
          paste0('_cx')
      )
    ,`Interactome`=
      c(avail_ovl_pea %>%
          paste0('_pea')
        ,avail_ovl_cx %>%
          paste0('_cx')
      )
    ,`Pathogenesis model`=
      divnn_model_train_inputs %>%
      names()
  ) %>%
  lapply(X=names(.),Y=.,\(X,Y)
    data.frame(step=X,model=Y[[X]])
  ) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.) %>%
  separate(model,c('B','A_pathway'),sep='\\.') %>%
  separate(A_pathway,c(paste0('A',1:3),'pathway'),sep='_') %>%
  unite(A,A1,A2,A3,sep='_') %>%
  lapply(X=1,Y=.,\(X,Y)
    expand.grid(
        step=
          Y$step %>%
          unique()
        ,B=
          Y$B %>%
          unique()
        ,A=
          Y$A %>%
          unique()
        ,pathway=
          Y$pathway %>%
          unique()
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        Y %>%
          mutate(avail=1)
        ,by=
          join_by(
            step
            ,B
            ,A
            ,pathway
          )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        avail=
          ifelse(
            is.na(avail)
            ,0
            ,1
          ) %>%
          factor()
      )
  ) %>%
  .[[1]] %>%
  left_join(
    read_csv('clist_abbreviation_stands_for.csv',show_col_types=F) %>%
      `colnames<-`(c('B','B1','B2'))
    ,by=join_by(B)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    read_csv('clist_abbreviation_stands_for.csv',show_col_types=F) %>%
      `colnames<-`(c('A','A1','A2'))
    ,by=join_by(A)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    A1=
      ifelse(
        str_detect(A1,'Endometrium')
        ,'Endometrial maturation'
        ,A1
      )
    ,A1=
      ifelse(
        str_detect(A1,'Placenta')
        ,'Placentation'
        ,A1
      )
    ,A1=
      ifelse(
        str_detect(A2,'chorioamnionitis')
        ,'Chorioamnionitis'
        ,A1
      )
    ,A1=
      ifelse(
        str_detect(A2,'HELLP')
        ,'HELLP syndrome'
        ,A1
      )
    ,A2=
      A2 %>%
      str_remove_all(', chorioamnionitis|, HELLP')
    ,B2=
      B2 %>%
      str_replace_all(', ',',\n')
  ) %>%
  mutate_at(c('B','A'),\(x)
    x %>%
      factor(unique(names(clist)))
  ) %>%
  arrange(B,A) %>%
  mutate_at(c('step','B1','A1'),\(x)
    x %>%
      factor(unique(.))
  ) %>%
  mutate_at(c('A2','B2'),\(x)
    x %>%
      factor(rev(unique(.)))
  )
```

```{r include=FALSE}
dea_results_lospe=
  gsai_results_lospe %>%
  select(B,A,query) %>%
  gather(type,set,-query) %>%
  group_by(set) %>%
  summarize(
    query=
      query %>%
      paste0(collapse=', ')
  ) %>%
  lapply(X=1,Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y %>%
      lapply(X=pull(.,set),Y=.,\(X,Y)
        Y %>%
          filter(set==X) %>%
          pull(query) %>%
          str_split(', ') %>%
          .[[1]] %>%
          unique()
      ) %>%
      `names<-`(pull(Y,set))
  ) %>%
  .[[1]] %>%
  lapply(X=names(.),Y=.,\(X,Y)
    dea_results[[X]]$result[Y[[X]],,drop=F] %>%
      rownames_to_column(var='feature') %>%
      select(feature,logFC) %>%
      mutate(phenotype=X)
  ) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.) %>%
  left_join(
    filter(.,phenotype=='OD_C_LOSPE')
    ,by=
      join_by(
        feature
      )
  ) %>%
  filter(phenotype.x!='OD_C_LOSPE') %>%
  gather(type,logFC,-feature,-phenotype.x,-phenotype.y) %>%
  mutate(
    type=
      ifelse(
        type=='logFC.x'
        ,'Associated factor'
        ,'Subtype'
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reg=
      ifelse(
        logFC>=0
        ,'U'
        ,'D'
      )
  ) %>%
  select(-logFC) %>%
  spread(type,reg) %>%
  unite(feature2,`Associated factor`,`Subtype`,sep='/') %>%
  mutate(
    feature2=
      paste0(
        feature
        ,' '
        ,'['
        ,feature2
        ,']'
      )
  ) %>%
  rename(A=phenotype.x,B=phenotype.y)
```

```{r}
clist_OD_pheno_exprs=
  clist %>%
  .[str_detect(names(.),'^OD_')] %>%
  pblapply(X=names(.),Y=.,\(X,Y)
    Y[[X]] %>%
      pData() %>%
      rownames_to_column(var='gsm') %>%
      mutate(grouping=X) %>%
      select(grouping,outcome,gse,gsm) %>%
      left_join(
        Y[[X]] %>%
          exprs() %>%
          sweep(
            MARGIN=1
            ,STATS=fData(Y[[X]])$AveExpr
            ,FUN='-'
          ) %>%
          t() %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          rownames_to_column(var='gsm')
        ,by=join_by(gsm)
      )
  ) %>%
  do.call(rbind,.) %>%
  rename(ori_outcome=outcome) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome0=
      case_when(
        str_detect(ori_outcome,'PE')~1
        ,TRUE~0
      ) %>%
      factor()
    ,outcome=
      case_when(
        str_detect(ori_outcome,'EO')~2
        ,str_detect(ori_outcome,'LO')~1
        ,TRUE~0
      ) %>%
      factor()
  ) %>%
  group_by(gsm) %>%
  mutate(weight=1/n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(grouping,ori_outcome,outcome0,outcome,weight,everything())
```

```{r}
clist_OD_uni_reg=function(voi,ooi){
  reg_mod=
    paste0(ooi,'~',voi,'+grouping') %>%
    as.formula()
  
  suppressWarnings(
    glm(
        formula=reg_mod
        ,data=clist_OD_pheno_exprs
        ,family=binomial()
        ,weights=weight
      ) %>%
      tidy() %>%
      filter(term==voi)
  )
}
```

```{r}
  select(-grouping,-ori_outcome,-outcome0,-outcome,-weight,-gse,-gsm) %>%

  pblapply(clist_OD_uni_reg,ooi='outcome0') %>%
  purrr::reduce(rbind)
```

```{r}
clist_OD_adjustment_check=function(voi,ooi,covariates){
  # covariates=
  #   clist_OD_inter_genes %>%
  #   filter(abs(r)>=0.4 & p<=0.05) %>%
  #   select(-r,-p) %>%
  #   filter(Var1==voi|Var2==voi) %>%
  #   gather(variable,value) %>%
  #   filter(variable!=voi) %>%
  #   pull(value) %>%
  #   unique()
  
  if(length(covariates)>0){
    reg_mod=
      covariates %>%
      `names<-`(as.character(.)) %>%
      lapply(\(x)paste0(ooi,'~',voi,'+',x,'+grouping')) %>%
      lapply(as.formula)
    
    reg_mod %>%
      pblapply(X=names(.),Y=.,\(X,Y)
        suppressWarnings(
          glm(
              formula=Y[[X]]
              ,data=clist_OD_pheno_exprs
              ,family=binomial()
              ,weights=weight
            ) %>%
            tidy() %>%
            filter(term==voi) %>%
            mutate(covariate=X) %>%
            select(term,covariate,everything())
        )
      ) %>%
      purrr::reduce(rbind)
  }else{
    NULL
  }
}
```

```{r}
clist_OD_uni_genes_colliders=
  clist_OD_uni_reg_results %>%
  mutate(
    OR=exp(estimate)
    ,LB=exp(estimate-std.error)
    ,UB=exp(estimate+std.error)
  ) %>%
  select(term,LB,UB) %>%
  right_join(
    clist_OD_uni_genes_adjustment_check_results %>%
      mutate(
        OR=exp(estimate)
        ,LB=exp(estimate-std.error)
        ,UB=exp(estimate+std.error)
      ) %>%
      select(term,covariate,OR)
    ,by=join_by(term)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (LB>0 & OR>UB)
    | (UB<0 & OR<LB)
  ) %>%
  select(var=term,collider=covariate)
```

```{r}
            str_remove_all('<Answer>|</Answer>') %>%

            paste0(collapse='|') %>%
            .[str_detect(.,'^[AB]$')] %>%
            .[1]
      ) %>%
      `names<-`(NULL)
    ,from=
      ifelse(

        ,gene1
        ,gene2
      )
    ,to=
      ifelse(
        answer=='A'
        ,gene2
        ,gene1
      )
  ) %>%
  select(from,to,answer,gene1,gene2,everything())
```

```{r}
eval_ci=list()
for(i in seq(31)){
  cat('Bootstrap',i)
  set.seed(i+seed)
  
  eval_ci[[i]]=
    list(
      training_set %>%
        select(obs=outcome0) %>%
        mutate(
          pred=
            model0 %>%
            predict(type='response')
        ) %>%
        mutate_at(c('pred'),\(x)factor(ifelse(x>0.5,1,0))) %>%
        mutate(gene='IGF1',outcome='PE')
      ,training_set %>%
        select(obs=outcome) %>%
        mutate(
          pred=
            model2 %>%
            predict(type='response')
        ) %>%
        mutate_at(c('pred'),\(x)factor(ifelse(x>0.5,1,0))) %>%
        mutate(gene='PAPPA2',outcome='EOPE')
    ) %>%
    c(training_set %>%
        select(obs=outcome,outcome2) %>%
        mutate(
          pred0=
            model0 %>%
            predict(type='response')
          ,pred2=
            model2 %>%
            predict(type='response')
        ) %>%
        mutate_at(c('pred0','pred2'),\(x)factor(ifelse(x>0.5,1,0))) %>%
        mutate(
          pred=
            case_when(
              pred0=='0'~0
              ,pred0=='1' & pred2=='0'~1
              ,pred0=='1' & pred2=='1'~2
            ) %>%
            factor()
        ) %>%
        select(-pred0,-pred2) %>%
        lapply(X=1,Y=.,\(X,Y)
          list(
            Y %>%
              mutate(
                pred=
                  ifelse(
                    pred=='0'
                    ,0
                    ,1
                  ) %>%
                  factor()
              ) %>%
              mutate(gene='MULTI',outcome='PE/ALL') %>%
              select(-outcome2)
            ,Y %>%
              filter(obs!='0') %>%
              mutate(
                pred=
                  ifelse(
                    pred=='1'
                    ,0
                    ,1
                  ) %>%
                  factor()
                ,obs=outcome2
              ) %>%
              select(-outcome2) %>%
              mutate(gene='MULTI',outcome='EOPE/PE')
          )
        ) %>%
        .[[1]]
    ) %>%
    lapply(\(x)
      x[list(
          seq(nrow(x))
          ,sample(seq(nrow(x)),nrow(x),T)
        )[[ifelse(i==31,1,2)]]
        ,
        ,drop=F
      ] %>%
        group_by_all() %>%
        summarize(n=n(),.groups='drop') %>%
        right_join(
          expand.grid(
              obs=0:1
              ,pred=0:1
            ) %>%
            mutate(cm=c('TN','FN','FP','TP')) %>%
            mutate_all(factor)
          ,by=join_by(obs,pred)
        ) %>%
        mutate_at('n',\(x)ifelse(is.na(x),0,x)) %>%
        fill(gene,outcome,.direction='down')
    ) %>%
    do.call(rbind,.) %>%
    select(gene,outcome,cm,n) %>%
    spread(cm,n) %>%
    mutate(
      TPR=TP/(TP+FN)
      ,TNR=TN/(TN+FP)
      ,PPV=TP/(TP+FP)
      ,NPV=TN/(TN+FN)
      ,ACC=(TP+TN)/(TP+FN+FP+TN)
      ,b=i
    )
  
  if(i==31) cat('\n')
  else cat('\r')
}

eval_ci=
  eval_ci %>%
  do.call(rbind,.)
```

```{r}
eval_ci_sum=
  eval_ci %>%
  filter(b!=31) %>%
  select(-TP,-FN,-FP,-TN) %>%
  left_join(
    eval_ci %>%
      filter(b==31) %>%
      select(gene,outcome,TP,FN,FP,TN)
    ,by=join_by(gene,outcome)
  ) %>%
  gather(metric,value,-b,-gene,-outcome,-TP,-FN,-FP,-TN) %>%
  group_by(gene,outcome,TP,FN,FP,TN,metric) %>%
  summarize(
    avg=mean(value)
    ,lb=mean(value)-qnorm(0.975)*sd(value)/sqrt(n())
    ,ub=mean(value)+qnorm(0.975)*sd(value)/sqrt(n())
    ,.groups='drop'
  )
```

```{r}
eval_ci_sum %>%
  unite(outcome_gene,outcome,gene,sep=' ~ ') %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_gene=
      outcome_gene %>%
      factor(rev(unique(.)))
    ,metric=
      metric %>%
      factor(rev(unique(.)))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(outcome_gene,avg)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lb,ymax=ub),width=0.25) +
  geom_point(na.rm=T) +
  facet_grid(metric~.) +
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}
eval_ci_sum %>%
  mutate_at(c('avg','lb','ub'),\(x)round(x*100,2)) %>%
  unite(ci,lb,ub,sep=', ') %>%
  mutate_at('ci',\(x)paste0('(',x,')')) %>%
  unite(estimate,avg,ci,sep=' ') %>%
  spread(metric,estimate) %>%
  knitr::kable() %>%
  kableExtra::kable_classic()
```
